plugins.name: Thai Buddhist Temple Set
plugins.description: This set consists of 5 structures found in most Buddhist temples (“Wat”) of central Thailand. The architecture is typical of this region as well as in Laos and Cambodia. It consists of: - 2x2 Ubosot (ordination hall) - 2x2 Ho Trai (scripture hall), with a placeable on water variant - 2x2 Chedi (stupa) - 1x1 small Sala (pavilion) - 2x1 temple gate Each structure offers varying influences of Park, Religion, and Culture. The design are based roughly on: the Ubosot of Wat Kong Krailat, Ho Trai of Wat Ban San, Chedi of Wat Traphang Thong, a small Sala in Wat Sopharam, and a temple gate of Wat Pho Tharam (and Wat Ban Kru), all located in Sukhothai province. Together you can build a Thai temple of your own, placing the different structures in any order you wish. All buildings costs no more than 2.000 and don’t require road access. Enjoy this little pocket of Thailand in your town!

plugins.name: Skyscrapers of Montreal
plugins.description: A pack of 3 skyscrapers of 3 different eras from Montreal, QC, Canada. All buildings are TTT commercial, rotation-aware (else symmetrical on two axes), and have night animation. 1. The Royal Bank Tower (Tour/Édifice de la Banque Royale; 5x5) was built between 1926 and 1928 as the head office of the Royal Bank of Canada. Towering 121 m (397 ft) over Montreal, it became the tallest building in the city, in Québec, in Canada, and in the entire British Empire. The bank relocated to the Place Ville-Marie in 1962, and today, after the 2012 restoration, the building is home to an opulent café and event venue. > A quintessential piece of Canadian neoclassical architecture; its copper roofing is something I've found to be especially common in Canada for whatever reason. I did take some creative liberties to fit it neatly within the TheoTown grid. 2. The Telus Tower (Tour/Place Telus; 5x3) is an office skyscraper containing the offices of Telus, a Canadian telecommunications company, among other tenants. Under the name C-I-L House (or the CIL Building), it was opened in 1960 as the headquarters of Canadian Industries Limited. > A very generic edifice of the International Style, fitting for any mid-century capitalist financial capital. My rendition of the tower has slightly shrunk its 135.6 m (445 ft) stature to keep a consistent window width and the correct number of them; irl, it should be a bit taller than the Royal Bank Tower. Major props to Eli/LS.35_J for helping with the roof! 3. The Maison Manuvie (Manulife House; 5x3) stands 116 m (380 ft) tall, an average height among its neighbours in Downtown Montreal. Since its completion in 2017, it has been co-owned by Manulife (Manuvie in French). > A modern 'glass box', typical of new office developments in Montreal, and anywhere else, really. I slightly shrank the building and simplified the structure of its lower levels to fit more elegantly in the TheoTown grid. (Man, the character limit sucks, eh?)
plugins.descriptionHtml:
A pack of 3 skyscrapers of 3 different eras from Montreal, QC, Canada. All buildings are TTT commercial, rotation-aware (else symmetrical on two axes), and have night animation.

1. The Royal Bank Tower (Tour/Édifice de la Banque Royale; 5x5) was built between 1926 and 1928 as the head office of the Royal Bank of Canada. Towering 121 m (397 ft) over Montreal, it became the tallest building in the city, in Québec, in Canada, and in the entire British Empire. The bank relocated to the Place Ville-Marie in 1962, and today, after the 2012 restoration, the building is home to an opulent café and event venue.
> A quintessential piece of Canadian neoclassical architecture; its copper roofing is something I've found to be especially common in Canada for whatever reason. I did take some creative liberties to fit it neatly within the TheoTown grid.

2. The Telus Tower (Tour/Place Telus; 5x3) is an office skyscraper containing the offices of Telus, a Canadian telecommunications company, among other tenants. Under the name C-I-L House (or the CIL Building), it was opened in 1960 as the headquarters of Canadian Industries Limited.
> A very generic edifice of the International Style, fitting for any mid-century capitalist financial capital. My rendition of the tower has slightly shrunk its 135.6 m (445 ft) stature to keep a consistent window width and the correct number of them; irl, it should be a bit taller than the Royal Bank Tower. Major props to Eli/LS.35_J for helping with the roof!

3. The Maison Manuvie (Manulife House; 5x3) stands 116 m (380 ft) tall, an average height among its neighbours in Downtown Montreal. Since its completion in 2017, it has been co-owned by Manulife (Manuvie in French).
> A modern 'glass box', typical of new office developments in Montreal, and anywhere else, really. I slightly shrank the building and simplified the structure of its lower levels to fit more elegantly in the TheoTown grid.

(Man, the character limit sucks, eh?)

plugins.name: Builder's Grab Bag
plugins.description: Builder's Grab Bag is a catch-all collection of small, useful, and slightly random props and buildings that never made it into the game or a dedicated pack. There's nothing too fancy or themed - just the stuff your vanilla city might need to feel a bit more detailed. Think of it less as a curated collection and more as a bunch of tools and convenient features that might come in handy during normal gameplay or a decorating session. What's inside: - Parking lots: Build your own, fully modular car parks from the provided tiles, or quickly place premade designs. They will make nearby inhabitants a little happier if you're lacking in public transport. - Small wires: A less heavy-duty equivalent of the regular power poles. They are a bit worse, but look great in rural and remote areas. - Bushes and tree planters: Some nature for city centers. Available with all vanilla tree types. - Fountains and sculptures: Several decorative pieces that will also provide culture influence, complete with impressive nighttime illumination. - Silos: Grain silo variants for rural areas. - Spotlights: Tall, vertical spotlights that will light up landmarks or entertainment venues at night. - Helipad: A fire department helipad that houses a single helicopter. Not functional at the moment, but will still prevent fires around. - Waste disposal facility: A new early game building that will handle garbage (at a cost) without the need for massive landfills. - Refreshed hedges: Vanilla hedge fences now have a new look, and three distinct color variants. - Refreshed wind turbines: Vanilla wind turbines no longer have unsightly objects on the ground and look smoother overall. - Refreshed ground types: Vanilla artificial ground types have been completely refreshed. Also includes some brand new ground tiles! (You can show or hide the replaced grounds through the settings.) Exactly what you'd expect to find in the back of the junk drawer (now dumped straight into your game).

plugins.name: TuringCompleteness
plugins.description: Actually, I have no idea which category this should go in. Hey everyone! This is XiaoYang, and I'm back with another plugin — this one's called Turing Completeness. It contains a relatively complete 1-bit digital circuit system. Logic gates. Memory. Adders. Decoders. These words sound like they belong in a computer architecture textbook, right? Well, now they're all in TheoTown. That's right — you can build a fully functional, programmable computer in TheoTown. Not a decoration. Not a prop. A real digital system, built from wires and logic gates, that actually computes. It can do logic (AND, OR, NOT, XOR). It can store data (D-latches, flip-flops). It can do arithmetic (adders, decoders). It can sense weather, fire, and Conway's Game of Life cells. It can control nukes, weather, fog, earthquakes, and tornadoes. It can play music (8-bit, 48 tones). It can display pixel graphics (black and white). It can even interact with Conway's Game of Life. This is a Turing-complete system. In theory, it can do anything a computer can do. The only limit? Your imagination. Note: This plugin requires a bit of patience and a learning curve Special thanks to Lobby for providing some source code and assets, to Jiuru for the suggestions and support, and to every tester who helped make this possible. All of this is built using TheoTown's native fun system — zero Lua involved. / Built entirely with fun — no Lua.

plugins.name: Muzej savremene umetnosti
plugins.description: The Building of the Museum of Contemporary Art is situated in New Belgrade , on the left bank of the Sava River , across the Belgrade Fortress . Its unique concept of the interior design and , on the other hand , its link to the surroundings represent an original solution which meets basic museological requirements . The building is an interesting example of museum architecture worldwide . It is surrounded by a sculpture park with works by the most significant Yugoslav sculptors of the 20th century . The main volume of the building is a polymorphous crystal comprised of six cubes with cut angles . The facade are mainly covered with white marble panels and partly with glass , and the sloping roof surface is covered with glass . The Museum ' s Building has been declared a cultural property of national interest in 1987. and is under the protection of Republic Institute for Protection of Cultural Monuments . In order to provide adequate conditions for primary functions of this exceptional building , the process of reconstruction and adaptation was initiated in 2008.Followed by numerous problems , the project lasted until October 20, 2017 when the building of the Museum of Contemporary Art reopened for visitors . size: 10X7（rectangle plugin） It supports the rectangle plugin. Please upgrade to version 1.12.26. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Chinese Scenic Road(road deco)
plugins.description: Friendly reminder: this is a ROAD DECORATION plugin. This plugin requires Advanced Road to provide a better experience. Additionally, this plugin only provides red and blue markings; yellow markings need to be obtained from the Advanced Road plugin. This is my first plugin, and I hope you like it. :) In China, red, yellow, and blue colored markings are applied to many tourist highways and rural roads to create scenic roads, known as "Rainbow Highways." This design originated in Liyang, Jiangsu, and aims to link the natural landscapes and cultural heritage along the route through a "transportation + tourism" model, enhancing the travel experience and boosting regional economic development. If you find any issues with the plugin, please send an email to 370950844@qq.com or join QQ group 700250215 and @ the author for feedback.

plugins.name: Tianjin Ancient Culture Street
plugins.description: Jinmen Guli, also known as Tianjin’s Ancient Culture Street, is located in Nankai District and serves as the birthplace of Tianjin as well as a signature landmark of the city. Centered on the Tianhou Palace, one of the world’s three major Mazu temples, the street is flanked by imposing archways bearing such names as “Jinmen Guli.” It brings together time-honored brands like Zhang’s Clay Figures and Yangliuqing New Year Prints, encapsulating more than six centuries of Tianjin’s history and folk culture, and is designated a national AAAAA‑rated tourist attraction.

plugins.description: Hey everyone! Sorry, my English isn't great — this part was translated with software, so please bear with me if anything sounds off. This plugin started with my very first village — Rape Flower Town — and has since grown across my virtual worlds: Blue Mountain, Hehenia, Pelican Town, and Youmadi. It's not just a building pack — it's a summary of every city I've ever built in TheoTown. plugins.name: Dali Chongsheng Temple Pagodas
plugins.description: Join our DC server https://discord.gg/KvgEPAS5F2 This plugin includes two buildings: **Qianxun Pagoda:** Built during the reign of Quan Fengyou of the Nanzhao Kingdom in the Tang Dynasty (823–859 AD), it stands 69.13 meters tall. It is a 16-story square, multi-eaved, hollow brick pagoda, typical of Tang Dynasty architecture. The base is 9.9 meters wide. "Qianxun" (xun is an ancient unit of length, approximately 2.67 meters) emphasizes its height. The pagoda's shape resembles a giant brushstroke, showcasing the weighty, solemn, and majestic style of Tang Dynasty architecture. **South/North Pagodas:** These two smaller pagodas, built later than the Qianxun Pagoda, were constructed during the reigns of Duan Zhengyan and Duan Zhengxing of the Dali Kingdom (1108–1172 AD). Both are 42.19 meters tall. They are 10-story octagonal, multi-eaved, hollow brick pagodas with a conical outline, typical of Song Dynasty architecture. The pagodas are covered with reliefs of Buddha images, lotus flowers, auspicious clouds, vases, and other decorative motifs. The two pagodas are 97 meters apart, serving as protective guardians of the main pagoda. #Author: Luyu_Annian

This plugin brings one of Chongqing's iconic skyscrapers into the game as an 8×8 Commercial building, making it a perfect addition to modern downtown areas and high-density business districts. To enhance the nighttime atmosphere, we included lighting and LED animations inspired by the real building's appearance. These effects were designed to capture the vibrant skyline and distinctive night scenery that Chongqing is famous for. Westin Forebase Financial Plaza, often known as The Westin Chongqing Liberation Square, is a prominent mixed-use complex located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing, China. Standing at 245.3 meters tall, the skyscraper combines office spaces, retail facilities, and a five-star hotel within a single development, and is well known for its iconic rooftop facilities overlooking the city skyline. plugins.name: TIV-2 (BETA!)
plugins.description: Good evening everyone, Twosc567 here! Today I’m excited to present the TIV-2 (BETA!) plugin. TIV 2 (Tornado Intercept Vehicle 2) is a heavy-armored vehicle built to study tornadoes from point-blank range. It’s got a low, reinforced chassis, massive wheels, protective plating, and a roof-mounted turret loaded with scientific gear and cameras. Thanks to its rugged build and stabilization systems, the TIV 2 can survive extreme weather and gather data right next to or even straight inside a tornado. Why is it in beta? Right now, it doesn't spawn on roads yet, and there is no rear-view camera/angle. But both of these issues will definitely be fixed in future updates. Also, I'm not 100% sure about the graphics/textures because I've only just started getting the hang of this game's art style. I'll be working on improving this as fast as I can! Still, I really hope you guys enjoy it. I’d appreciate any support and feedback/criticism right now!
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Good evening everyone, Twosc567 here! Today I’m excited to present the TIV-2 (BETA!) plugin.

TIV 2 (Tornado Intercept Vehicle 2) is a heavy-armored vehicle built to study tornadoes from point-blank range. It’s got a low, reinforced chassis, massive wheels, protective plating, and a roof-mounted turret loaded with scientific gear and cameras. Thanks to its rugged build and stabilization systems, the TIV 2 can survive extreme weather and gather data right next to or even straight inside a tornado.

Why is it in beta? Right now, it doesn't spawn on roads yet, and there is no rear-view camera/angle. But both of these issues will definitely be fixed in future updates.

Also, I'm not 100% sure about the graphics/textures because I've only just started getting the hang of this game's art style. I'll be working on improving this as fast as I can!

Still, I really hope you guys enjoy it. I’d appreciate any support and feedback/criticism right now!

Founded on October 8, 1904, it is a historical, educational, and social landmark in the capital of Paraná, brazil. IPIC directly participated in the founding of the Evangelical Beneficent Society (SEB), which maintains the Mackenzie Evangelical Hospital, in addition to managing the Hermínia Scheleder Home and the Miriam Daycare Center. plugins.name: Boeing sonic cruiser
plugins.description: Passenger capacity: 250 Features rotation-aware aircraft decoration Price: 700,000 The Boeing Sonic Cruiser was a concept jet airliner with a delta wing–canard configuration. It was distinguished from conventional airliners by its delta wing and high-subsonic/transonic cruising speed of up to Mach 0.98. Boeing first proposed it in 2001, but airlines generally preferred lower operating costs over higher speed. Boeing ended the Sonic Cruiser project in December 2002 and shifted to the slower (Mach 0.85) but more fuel-efficient 7E7 (later named 787 Dreamliner) airliner.

It comes with Yak-38 (the first VTOL fighter generation of USSR). ●In the fisrt edition it only for decoration but thank to Thidagtahu, for help me with the animation. Now this plugin not only have night, radar, flag animation but it also support rotation now. ●Here is the history of Novorossiysk, it was a conventionally powered aircraft carrier that served the Soviet Navy and the Russian Navy from 1982 to 1993. She was the third Kiev-class vessel. After the break-up of the Soviet Union. In 1995 the Novorossiysk hulk, which had suffered a serious engine room fire two years earlier, was sold for scrapping, and was broken up in 1997 at Pohang, South Korea. ●New update: now you can add it as a composition for easier building. And i also fix some wrong place detail. Enjoy

plugins.name: CBRT Tower Pack
plugins.description: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkiye Tower the tallest building in Turkiye. This plugin is created using animated textures developed specifically for the CBRT Tower. This method ensures significant space efficiency within the plugin. The plugin includes building shadow effects. By placing fence shadows to the left of the structure, you can cast shade onto building facades. Angular shadows extend up to two tiles, while straight shadows allow you to shade buildings aligned in parallel. Flat roof towers feature roof shadows added through the upgrade process. Place smaller buildings to the right of large ones within frame 1, then apply the upgrade. The towers are available in both commercial and residential versions. Since they are tool group, you can access them by clicking the arrows in your toolbar. Night animations are probability-based. Feel free to share any questions or suggestions about the plugin in the comments.Enjoy! Update: New compositions and shadow fences have been added.

plugins.name: PAGCOR Tower
plugins.description: Hello everyone, our plugin for a day is one of the Philippine skyscrapers that has never been built; the second plugin is "PAGCOR Tower." Update (6-30-2026) V 2.1- I forgot to put a night light on the upper part of the building; Improved Night Light. The PAGCOR Tower was a proposed observation tower located close to Manila Bay in Parañaque, Metro Manila, Philippines, with a height of 665 meters. The tower was intended to serve as the focal point of the recently opened Pagcor City (also known as Entertainment City Manila), an integrated recreational area with hotels, shopping centers, casinos, and convention centers. It would have been one of the highest towers not merely in the Philippines but in the whole world if it had been built. The influences applied in this plugin are: Culture (315) - The Pagcor Tower itself was a landmark that was supposedly a focal point of the establishing Entertainment City near Manila Bay. Park (50) - The ground floor had trees and a water fountain; it is considered a mini park. Additionally, one of the reasons is its long elevation, which allows those elevated atop the tower to take in views of your lovely city. Management (100) - Like Philippine Diamond Tower, Pagcor Tower was also a broadcasting tower that served as an antenna, it radiated information like news and management to the people in your area. Notwithstanding the favorable advantages, the maintenance cost of the building is 1,475 Theons to keep the building standing tall. Enjoy :)

plugins.name: Philippine Diamond Tower
plugins.description: Hello mga Kababayan, this is Philippine Diamond Tower, (1st plugin) one of the Cancelled skyscrapers in the Philippines. Today, this plugin has been updated (V 2.2) "Improved Ground Texture" Note: Due to the limited source of the PDT design, most of the details of PDT are made in my analytical imagination and theory from that limited source. The Philippine Diamond Tower (PDT) was a high-rise observational and broadcast tower initially planned to be built on North Triangle, Quezon City. Additionally, this tower served as a landmark not just for Metro Manila but for the whole Philippines. The height of the building was purposefully planned to be 612 meters; its height represents Philippine independence that occurred on June 12, 1898. The influences applied in this plugin are: Culture (300) - The PDT was a Philippine landmark as a whole, due to its triangular foundational design that embodying the 3 stars (islands), the culture area from PDT are abundant and spacious. Park (50) - The ground floor of PDT had a grass and trees, it is considered as a mini park. Additionally, the elevation of the tower is one of the factor, the people on the top of the tower can enjoy the view of the landscape of your beautiful city. Management (100) - Since PDT was a broadcasting tower that served as an antenna, it radiated information like news and management to the people in your area. Despite the enormous influence, the monthly cost of the tower is inevitable, it costs 1,450 Theons for the structure maintenance and especially the culture, park, and management influence provider. ~Updated on May 30, 2026

Additionally, this tower served as a landmark not just for Metro Manila but for the whole Philippines. The influences applied in this plugin are:
Culture (300) - The PDT was a Philippine landmark as a whole, due to its triangular foundational design that embodying the 3 stars (islands), the culture area from PDT are abundant and spacious.
Park (50) - The ground floor of PDT had a grass and trees, it is considered as a mini park. Additionally, the elevation of the tower is one of the factor, the people on the top of the tower can enjoy the view of the landscape of your beautiful city.
Management (100) - Since PDT was a broadcasting tower that served as an antenna, it radiated information like news and management to the people in your area.

Despite the enormous influence, the monthly cost of the tower is inevitable, it costs 1,450 Theons for the structure maintenance and especially the culture, park, and management influence provider.

~Updated on May 30, 2026

plugins.name: Burj Mubarak Al-Kabir
plugins.description: As-salamu alaykum jamee'an السلام عليكم جميعاً (Peace be upon you all). In this series, I'm going to recreate a plugin from various structural designs that come from SkyscraperPage/S.H. Lee's taller/lower than Burj Khalifa videos (I have done this since 2022). And the tenth plugin for today is the infamous Burj Mubarak al Kabir in Kuwait. Special thanks to Kuwait and Architect Santiago Calatrava for bringing this building to life. As the heart of the newly built Silk City, I found this building one of the most beautiful and intriguing megatall skyscrapers, as it is the landmark for the whole city. This 7x7 area building is a commercial building that has a capacity of 6500 workers. ‎The Burj Mubarak Al Kabir is a proposed 1,001-meter skyscraper planned for Kuwait's new Silk City. Its height is a tribute to the famous Arabic folktales, One Thousand and One Nights. Designed by architect Santiago Calatrava, the building looks like a traditional Islamic minaret and features three interlocking towers that twist as they climb. This unique shape helps the building stay stable against strong 150 mph desert winds. The tower will have 234 floors and act as a complete vertical city. It will feature seven distinct "vertical villages" containing homes, offices, hotels, and shops. Located in northern Kuwait, it will connect to Kuwait City via a major new bridge. Because of its massive scale, the tower is expected to take about 25 years to build. I hope this building will be built somewhere between 2035 and 2050, as this is one of the megatall skyscrapers that can be built in this century. Another thing is thank you for your positive feedback on Sky City One, Twin CTISC, and Bank of America to the point that the moderators placed a feature badge on them, I really appreciate it.

plugins.description: सभी को नमस्ते (Hello everyone), in this series, I'm going to recreate a plugin from various structural designs that come from SkyscraperPage/S.H. Lee's taller/lower than Burj Khalifa videos (I have done this since 2022). And the ninth plugin for today is Dynamix Balwas Tower, or what people refer to as the India Tower. Special thanks to India and 'Foster and Partners' for conceptualizing this building. For me, the name for the building "Dynamix Balwas Tower" sounded way cooler. This 6x6 area building is a commercial building that has a capacity of 4917 workers. (when you flip the two two-digit number of employees, it resembles the year when India was founded). ‎The India Tower (originally known as the Park Hyatt Tower or Dynamix Balwas Tower) was a megatall skyscraper initially planned to be built in Marine Lines, Mumbai. The height of the building was purposefully planned to be 707 meters, its height represents a monumental leap into the 21st century as one of the tallest architectural achievements in human history. Originally planned for completion in 2016, construction was put on hold in May 2011 due to disputes between the developers and Mumbai's civic authorities, and later cancelled in 2015. Hope you enjoy this building. Thank you for downloading.

Make your airports more realistic with these add-ons:
- runway lights (REIL system): placed at the entrance or exit of a runway in case of night or poor visibility
- some fuel tanks: just decorations, but at least your planes have to refuel
- 3 radar surveillance towers (2 animated for variety): to detect aircraft around your airports
- 1 Doppler radar tower: whatever that is....
- several markers: airport markers contain useful info about gates, runways and others
- 1 non-functional helipad

• increased radar tower speed a little

Stay tuned for more features and variations in future updates!

plugins.name: The Bosscha Observatory
plugins.description: The Bosscha Observatory is the oldest astronomical observatory in Indonesia, located in Lembang, West Java, approximately 15 kilometers north of Bandung. Established in 1923 by the Nederlandsch-Indische Sterrenkundige Vereeniging, it serves as a premier research institution for astronomy in Southeast Asia and is currently managed by the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB). Housing the iconic Zeiss double refractor telescope under its distinctive white dome, the site is recognized as a national cultural heritage asset and continues to facilitate celestial observations and public science education.

plugins.name: The Wenchuan moment
plugins.description: The Wenchuan earthquake on May 12th occurred at 14:28:04 on May 12, 2008, with a magnitude of 8.0. Shaking was felt in most regions of China, and even in countries including Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines and Japan. This earthquake was the most destructive and widely felt earthquake since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It caused 69,227 deaths, 17,923 missing, 374,643 injured, left tens of millions of people displaced, and resulted in direct economic losses of more than 800 billion yuan. Thanks to the joint support from all parties, more than 80,000 survivors were rescued, 4 million person-times of wounded received medical treatment, and the reconstruction of the disaster-stricken areas was completed in 2010. This passage is dedicated to commemorating the victims and paying tribute to the rescuers from all over the country who never feared sacrifice.

plugins.name: PARADE IN 9 MAY | Fetris
plugins.description: Hello everyone, this is Fetris! The May 9th Parade is a traditional event held in Russia and other post-Soviet countries in honor of Victory Day over Nazi Germany in World War II. This day is celebrated on May 9, since it was on this day in 1945 that the act of surrender of Germany was signed. The parade in Moscow on Red Square is the largest and most significant event. It is attended by military personnel, veterans, representatives of various organizations and youth groups. The parade showcases military equipment, modern weapons, and also includes aerial displays. The May 9 parade symbolizes the memory of the feat of the Soviet people during the war and serves as a reminder of the importance of peace and harmony. Various events are also held in other cities of Russia and abroad, including rallies, concerts and processions of the “Immortal Regiment”, where people carry portraits of their relatives who participated in the war. Fetris

plugins.name: MARACANÃ STADIUM
plugins.description: Hello! Here's one of my greatest creations: none other than the Maracana stadium, one of the most historic and emblematic places in the history of this beautiful sport called football. The Maracanã is one of the few stadiums that have hosted two FIFA World Cup finals: one in 1950 where Uruguay was crowned champion against Brazil, and another in 2014 where Germany triumphed over Argentina. Long before, this stadium had a capacity of over 100,000 people, making it one of the largest in the world. It was later remodeled and its capacity was reduced to the current 78,000. Flamengo and Fluminense play their home games here, as well as, of course, the Brazilian national team. It's located in Rio de Janeiro. The plugin is 15x15 pixels in size and features nighttime animation. I hope you like this stadium. Greetings to all the people of Brazil who requested this sports giant. Credits for the trees: Rendering
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Hello! Here's one of my greatest creations: none other than the Maracana stadium, one of the most historic and emblematic places in the history of this beautiful sport called football.
The Maracanã is one of the few stadiums that have hosted two FIFA World Cup finals: one in 1950 where Uruguay was crowned champion against Brazil, and another in 2014 where Germany triumphed over Argentina.
Long before, this stadium had a capacity of over 100,000 people, making it one of the largest in the world. It was later remodeled and its capacity was reduced to the current 78,000.
Flamengo and Fluminense play their home games here, as well as, of course, the Brazilian national team. It's located in Rio de Janeiro.

The plugin is 15x15 pixels in size and features nighttime animation.
I hope you like this stadium. Greetings to all the people of Brazil who requested this sports giant.

Credits for the trees: Rendering

plugins.name: MUNCH
plugins.description: The Munch Museum was designed by the Spanish firm Estudio Herreros and was officially opened to the public on October 22, 2021 after a long period of construction. The museum houses over a thousand works by Edvard Munch and aims to carry history through contemporary architectural language and connect the urban fabric of Oslo with the fjords. This 13-storey building, standing at a height of 60 meters, features an ascending visitor circulation system. The ground floor houses various public facilities such as restaurants, cafes, and libraries. As one ascends higher, the space becomes more and more pure, eventually leading to a rooftop platform equipped with an observatory, from where one can overlook the entire Oslo panorama. The building's facade is composed of perforated aluminum panels, which change dynamically in response to light and climate. The overall design follows the principles of passive energy conservation, integrating ecological consciousness with architectural expression. The art gallery not only showcases Munch's artistic legacy, but also strives to become a cultural vitality center accessible to all citizens. size:5X9（rectangle plugin） We would like to express our sincere gratitude to SnowBall_RTZ for his assistance with the night scene feature of this plugin. It is undeniable that he is one of the best plugin creators in China, which has made this plugin more complete and refined. Wish his Snowy Sky Studio could bring more and better plugins to all the players. The building textures were redrawn and the red LED lights were updated, making the plugin more in line with real buildings. And it supports the rectangle plugin. Please upgrade to version 1.12.26. SnowBall_RTZ & H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: AMERICAN BUILDING | Fetris
plugins.description: Hello everyone, this is Fetris! American brick and stone high-rises represent an interesting aspect of architecture, especially in the context of urban development. In the United States, high-rise buildings began to be built in the late 19th century, and many of them were made of brick and stone, which gave them a distinctive appearance and strength. Historical Context. Early Skyscrapers: The first skyscrapers, such as the Scripps Building in New York (1894), were built using brick and stone. These materials provided the necessary strength and stability of the buildings. Architectural Styles: High-rise buildings were often built in a variety of architectural styles, such as neo-Gothic, Art Deco and Art Nouveau, which used brick and stone to create decorative elements. Fetris

plugins.name: Feili Center
plugins.description: The New World Feili Center is located in Qianjiang Century City, Hangzhou. It is a landmark twin-tower complex with a total floor area of approximately 310,000 square meters. The architecture is highly eye-catching, with a facade made of turquoise green glass and white streamlined aluminum panels. Through its unique curved triangular design, it creates striking light and shadow effects, appearing to “glow” on its own in sunlight. The two towers stand about 250 meters tall (59 floors). Among them, T1 serves as a 5A grade-A office building, T2 houses the Lamborghini Executive Residences, and the podium T3 is the Tonino Lamborghini Venoto Hotel, integrating high-end office space, luxury living, and business hotel functions into one complex.

plugins.name: Custom Topics
plugins.description: New Feature: You can now customize the color of your topics 😉 Create fully customizable topics with complete flexibility. Q: What are Topics? A: Topics are short texts shown below the loading screen when entering a city, leaving a city, saving the city, and during similar events. Q: What is it for? A: Just for fun. You can create any text you like. Q: Can I write topics in my own language? A: Yes. You can write topics in any language supported by the game. Q: Why doesn't my topic appear every time? A: Custom topics appear with a 50% chance so they don't replace the game's default topics too often. Q: Can other players see my topics? A: No. Topics are only visible to you. But you can always take a screenshot and share it :D How to Use: 1. Tap or click the pencil icon to open the Topic Manager. 2. Tap or click the + button next to Add New Topic. 3. Enter your custom topic. 4. Use the X button to disable a topic, or the ✔ button to enable it. 5. Tap Save. 6. Restart the game to apply the changes. • Supports all languages available in the game. • You can hide the Manager icon from the in-game settings. Note: Custom topics appear with a 50% probability to avoid interfering with the game’s default topics and to remain compliant with existing rules. Enjoy creating your own topics ❤️
plugins.descriptionHtml:
New Feature:
You can now customize the color of your topics 😉

Create fully customizable topics with complete flexibility.

Q: What are Topics?
A: Topics are short texts shown below the loading screen when entering a city, leaving a city, saving the city, and during similar events.

Q: What is it for?
A: Just for fun. You can create any text you like.

Q: Can I write topics in my own language?
A: Yes. You can write topics in any language supported by the game.

Q: Why doesn't my topic appear every time?
A: Custom topics appear with a 50% chance so they don't replace the game's default topics too often.

Q: Can other players see my topics?
A: No. Topics are only visible to you. But you can always take a screenshot and share it :D

How to Use:
1. Tap or click the pencil icon to open the Topic Manager.
2. Tap or click the + button next to Add New Topic.
3. Enter your custom topic.
4. Use the X button to disable a topic, or the ✔ button to enable it.
5. Tap Save.
6. Restart the game to apply the changes.

• Supports all languages available in the game.
• You can hide the Manager icon from the in-game settings.

Note: Custom topics appear with a 50% probability to avoid interfering with the game’s default topics and to remain compliant with existing rules.

Enjoy creating your own topics ❤️

plugins.name: Becak Depot (Pedicab)
plugins.description: (New Update) : Adjusting pricing & influence radius and fixing category Becak is a traditional indonesian transportation which have cultural history and big impact in Indonesia. In other countries, Becak is often called Pedicab and have unlimited variation. But the biggest difference between Indonesia and other country's pedicab is the cultural status. Most Becak has unique art or drawing painted in interior and exterior which give this transportation huge cultural boost. But sadly, becak is nowhere to be found today. Most place where you find Becak in old times is currently vanished. This is because many ridesharing service who has cheapest and fastest service greatly make becak seems inferior. On today market you can only find this transportation in tourism place, and depending on the location, the price is hard to explain, only riches can enjoy this. Why this transportation so expensive is because its comfortability which cannot be beaten by any land-based transportation. If you wanna garnish your city with the cultural transportation, this is the best shot! Type : Transportation Size : 1x1 Montly price : agree or disagree, 105 Theon Atribute : 250 Transportation, 40 Culture Nightmode : ON On this plugin you will get 4 depot variation and 4 becak colour. Credit to lobby for tree texture and credit to Om Hendra for depot design.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
(New Update) : Adjusting pricing & influence radius and fixing category

Becak is a traditional indonesian transportation which have cultural history and big impact in Indonesia. In other countries, Becak is often called Pedicab and have unlimited variation. But the biggest difference between Indonesia and other country's pedicab is the cultural status. Most Becak has unique art or drawing painted in interior and exterior which give this transportation huge cultural boost. But sadly, becak is nowhere to be found today. Most place where you find Becak in old times is currently vanished. This is because many ridesharing service who has cheapest and fastest service greatly make becak seems inferior. On today market you can only find this transportation in tourism place, and depending on the location, the price is hard to explain, only riches can enjoy this. Why this transportation so expensive is because its comfortability which cannot be beaten by any land-based transportation. If you wanna garnish your city with the cultural transportation, this is the best shot!

Size : 1x1
Montly price : agree or disagree, 105 Theon
Atribute : 250 Transportation, 40 Culture

On this plugin you will get 4 depot variation and 4 becak colour. Credit to lobby for tree texture and credit to Om Hendra for depot design.

plugins.description: Wangchao Center is located in the core area of Hangzhou’s Qianjiang Century City. It is an urban complex integrating office, commercial, hotel, and residential functions. The main tower stands 288 meters tall with 57 floors, and has a total floor area of 125,000 square meters. It is expected to become fully operational in early 2026. Designed by the American firm SOM, the building is inspired by the Qiantang River tide and the ripples of West Lake; its streamlined facade integrates the essence of Hangzhou’s landscapes into a modern architectural language. Eight champagne-colored concrete-filled steel tube mega-columns spiral upward, working in coordination with the central core to bear structural forces, offering both sculptural presence and strong seismic and wind resistance. plugins.name: aCB in Jinji Lake
plugins.description: This is a commercial building modeled after a real structure in Suzhou Jinji Lake CBD. It is a Theotown plugin created by kmr jin. The building features a modern tall tower with sleek glass facades, paired with a lower podium that includes green rooftop areas. Designed to combine shopping and business functions, it reflects the contemporary urban commercial style of Suzhou’s central business district. The building features a tall modern tower with a sleek blue-gray glass curtain wall that gives it a polished and professional look. The glass panels are arranged in a neat grid pattern, creating a sense of order and modernity. The top of the tower has a distinctive textured edge with a honeycomb-like design, adding a unique decorative touch to its silhouette. At the base, a wider podium connects to the tower, with large transparent glass windows that suggest open and accessible commercial spaces. The podium also includes small green rooftop areas, blending urban functionality with a touch of natural elements. The overall appearance is streamlined and sophisticated, perfectly embodying the contemporary commercial style of Suzhou’s Jinji Lake CBD.

plugins.name: The monument in Pskov | Fetris
plugins.description: The monument in Pskov, dedicated to the recognition of the city's military glory, was erected in 2011. This monument has become a symbol of the historical heritage and military valor of the Pskov people. The monument is a stele on which is placed the city’s coat of arms and an inscription confirming Pskov’s status as a city of military glory. Pskov was awarded this title for its rich history associated with the defense of the Motherland, especially during various wars and conflicts. The Pskov region has many historical monuments and places associated with military history, including fortresses, churches and memorials that remind of the heroism of the defenders of the city and the entire country. The monument has become an important part of the cultural and historical landscape of Pskov, attracting the attention of both local residents and tourists

plugins.name: U.C.A.M. of GAFA
plugins.description: The University City Art Museum of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts is located on the east side of the main entrance square of the University Town Campus of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts. It was completed in 2005. The museum has four floors with a total construction area of approximately 16,000 square meters. It is a comprehensive art museum that focuses on exhibitions, collections, art exchanges, academic research, and public services. The University Town Art Museum focuses on promoting, researching and displaying young art, emphasizing contemporaneity, experimentation and internationalization. In recent years, the annual graduate works exhibition of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts has become an important event that attracts high attention and praise from the art circle and citizens of Guangzhou. Contemporary young art will also be carried out in the University Town Art Museum and the open space of the University Town Campus of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, with interdisciplinary and experimental exhibitions and exchanges. The collection mainly consists of outstanding graduation works in recent years and art works from international exchanges.Of course, this is also my Alma mater art gallery. I am extremely happy about the approval of this plugin. This is the first plugin I created, but due to some technical issues, it took me a full year to fix and release it. This also means that I have been developing the plugin for a full year. Over these 365 days, I am extremely grateful for everyone's love and support for me. Therefore, the price will remain at 30 diamonds until the night scene update. I hope that in the coming days, I can continue to bring you more interesting plugins!!! There are no night views for the moment. I will update them when I have time. size：6X6 H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: MIL Mi-26
plugins.description: The Mil Mi-26 is the world’s largest and most powerful serially produced helicopter, designed and manufactured by the Soviet Union’s Mil Moscow Helicopter Plant. First introduced in the late 1970s, it was developed to meet the demanding needs of heavy cargo transport in both military and civilian operations. Renowned for its exceptional lifting capacity, the Mi-26 is capable of carrying payloads of up to 20 tons, including vehicles, equipment, or large groups of personnel. Its advanced rotor system and twin-engine configuration enable reliable performance even in harsh and remote environments. Today, the Mi-26 remains in service in several countries, where it continues to play a crucial role in logistics, disaster relief, firefighting, and infrastructure support, reflecting its enduring engineering significance and operational versatility.

plugins.name: Sisyphus Statue
plugins.description: There's a 4×4 statue, inspired by The Myth of Sisyphus. It provides 80 culture influence. "One must imagine Sisyphus happy" is the famous concluding line of Albert Camus’s 1942 philosophical essay, The Myth of Sisyphus. Camus uses the Greek myth of Sisyphus—who is condemned to eternally push a boulder up a hill, only to watch it roll back down—as a metaphor for the "absurdity" of human existence: our search for meaning in a meaningless universe. However, Camus argues that Sisyphus becomes an "absurd hero" by fully accepting his fate without relying on false hope. His happiness comes from his profound rebellion; the very act of owning his destiny and struggling against the absurdity is enough to fill his heart.

plugins.name: Villa Isola UPI
plugins.description: Villa Isola is an iconic Art Deco building located at the northern end of the Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia (UPI) campus in Bandung, Indonesia. Built in 1933 by the architect C.P. Wolff Schoemaker for the Italian tycoon Dominique Willem Berretty, the structure is celebrated for its curved facade, tiered gardens, and commanding views of the city. Originally a private residence, it now serves as the university's central administration building (Rectorate) and stands as one of Indonesia's most significant examples of modern colonial architecture.

plugins.name: Pacific Century Place Jakarta
plugins.description: Pacific Century Place (PCP) Jakarta is a premium, Grade A office tower located in the heart of the Sudirman Central Business District (SCBD). plugins.name: xcp330bag
plugins.description: It is a flat top tower crane designed for high rise construction and large scale engineering projects. It features a rated load moment of 330 ton meters and a maximum lifting capacity of 18 tons. The jib length reaches 75 meters with a tip load of 2.5 tons. It has a fixed height of 51 meters and an attached height of 156 meters. This crane adopts a flat top structure for convenient installation and disassembly. It uses modular design for lightweight components and optimized lifting performance. The jib and counter jib connect to the slewing tower via clamp plates ensuring safety and ease of use. The hoisting mechanism has a speed range of 0 to 90 meters per minute with a rope capacity of 804 meters and a power of 75 kW. The trolleying mechanism operates at 0 to 65 meters per minute powered by 9 kW. The slewing mechanism provides stable rotation for precise positioning.

plugins.name: Enzo Ferrari’s House
plugins.description: This building, known as the "House of Enzo Ferrari" or "Former Residence of Enzo Ferrari", is located on the outskirts of Modena in the Emilia-Romagna region of Italy, adjacent to the famous Fiorano circuit. It is not merely a house; it is a living witness to Ferrari's history and the spirit of its founder. Enzo Ferrari personally selected the site and supervised the construction of the Fiorano circuit (conceived in the 1960s and completed in 1972), which served as the exclusive test track for Ferrari's F1 cars and road cars. His home is built right beside the racetrack, making it convenient for him to directly observe the testing situation of the racing car from his office or home at any time. He lived here in the final years of his life (approximately from the mid-to-late 1970s until his death in 1988). This is his personal space and also an extension of his work enthusiasm. It is a typical country villa in the style of the Emilia-Romagna region, usually described as an elegant yellow cottage with local characteristic arches and red-tiled roofs. It looks understated and comfortable, in contrast to Ferrari's industrial empire, but its location highlights its core position. Many of Enzo Ferrari's original appearances and personal items during his life have been preserved, including his study, bedroom, living room, etc. The interior decoration reflects his personal taste and the characteristics of that era. Here, there is no hustle and bustle of the Maranello factory, but it has the purest Ferrari DNA... size：2X2 We updated the ground textures and night animations. Ferrari set the fastest lap during this winter test this year. Therefore, we will maintain the price of 30 diamonds. We hope Ferrari will wake up in 2026... By the way, if I have some spare time later, I will draw brand new F1 packages and the Maranello factory packages. See you then. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Guangzhou R&F Center
plugins.description: R&f Center is a skyscraper located in Zhujiang New Town, Tianhe District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, China. After its completion, it will serve as the headquarters of R&F Properties. It is 243 meters high, has 55 floors and a total construction area of 162,477 square meters. This building serves as the office location for institutions such as the Consulate General of Spain in Guangzhou and the Consulate General of Chile in Guangzhou. It was completed and put into use in 2007. Among them, floors 45 to 54 are the headquarters of R&F Properties, while the other floors are leased only and not sold. The property management is handled by Savills. Designed by the international architectural design firm Aedas. The architectural design takes a simple architectural form as its theme, and the design concept is derived from the Chinese jade artifact "cong", which is square on the outside and round on the inside for over two thousand years. The square floor slab design enhances the practicality and flexibility of the building. By combining different floor slabs, different degrees of retreat can be achieved. The internal facilities include Chinese and Western restaurants, a coffee shop, a business center and a conference center. The floors above the fourth are office buildings with a standard floor height of 4.05 meters. They are equipped with 26 high-speed direct elevators and 3 sightseeing elevators. The entire building adopts a VAV central air conditioning system. The underground garage can provide 880 parking Spaces. size：5X5 It already has a night view.Corrected the exterior logo. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.description: The former headquarters of the Ministry of Justice (also known as the Red Brick Building) is located in Kasumigaseki, Tokyo. Built in 1895, it is a representative work of German-style (Neo-Baroque) public architecture from the Meiji era in Japan. After being damaged by the Great Kanto Earthquake and air raids, it was restored to its original appearance in 1994 and designated as an Important Cultural Property of Japan. Now serving as a legal history exhibition space, its unique exterior makes it a historical landmark in the modern Kasumigaseki office district. #Building Type: Management #Impact: Culture, Management #Update: Added shadows, missing pixels Join our DC server https://discord.gg/KvgEPAS5F2 Author:chaonimalebi，Rong，wang_zhong

plugins.name: BNI Trikora
plugins.description: The BNI Trikora, officially known as Gedung Bank BNI 1946, is a historic cultural heritage site located at the Titik Nol Kilometer (Zero Kilometer Point) in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Designed by Dutch architect Johan Louwrens Ghijsels and completed in 1922, the building features a distinctive Art Deco Indies architectural style characterized by pilar-adorned walls and decorative roosters that serve as natural ventilation. Throughout its history, the structure has served multiple functions: it was originally an office for the Dutch insurance company NILLMIJ, later a Japanese radio station called Hoso Kyoku during World War II, and then the headquarters for the newly formed Radio Republik Indonesia (RRI) in 1945. Since July 5, 1946, it has functioned as the first branch office of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), and it remains an active banking center and iconic landmark on Pangurakan Street (formerly Trikora Street). artwork by mathvii

plugins.name: Highrise in Zhengzhou 1
plugins.description: The reason why columns in high-rise buildings are usually designed to be massive is not primarily due to the magnitude of vertical loads, but rather due to the building’s height. As height increases, columns are subjected to significant shear forces and bending moments, which are typically addressed by enlarging their cross-sections. Kerez’s approach allows the columns become as thin as possible, while shear forces and bending moments are transferred to steel tension cables located at the building perimeter. This structural strategy results in extremely slender columns and a refined core structure.

plugins.descriptionHtml:
Hello everyone💫✨❄️
It's finally here😁

🥷🏻I present to you, my first version of a new plugin: "Ostrovsk Metro Transport"🚇

It contains:
Invisible depot💈
81-765 "Moscow"🚇
81-775 "Moscow 2020"🚇
81-717 "Number"🚇
81-710 "Hedgehog 3"🚇
81-720 "Yauza"🚇
81-725.2 "Baltiets"🚇
81-722.1🚇

plugins.name: Museum of Art Pudong
plugins.description: Museum of Art Pudong is a domain. The domain is Museum of Art Pudong.The domain is a medium consisting of four hectares of warm white granite stones assembled in a way that conjures up the irregular pattern of ‘crackled glass’. The domain is bordered in the west by water, the Huangpu River. The domain actually drops straight down to the water, with the stone becoming whiter there. The western side screen on the Bund will be programmed.The western side screen on the Bund will be installation spaces or performance spaces, during the day.The western side screen on the Bund will be programmed as a video space, during the evening and at night.The western side screen on the Bund will be a machine for surveying the Bund, a twin panorama.The western side screen on the Bund will be a reflection of this twin panorama, depending on the lighting used.The western side screen on the Bund will be a reflection of the artworks superimposed periodically over the view of the Bund, depending on the lighting used. The western side screen seen from the Bund will show the excitement and the museum’s visitors. The western side screen seen from the Bund will be an incredible tool for image artists and installation artists, especially for Chinese artists who like large dimensions. The western side screen on the Bund side, starting at the walkway, is an actual vision of the “Grand Verre”. The western side screen on the Bund side, starting at the walkway, is a joker designed to fascinate the crowd through fresh new images that disrupt the view of Shanghai and the Bund. The western side screen on the Bund side is a testament to the art of the 21st century. size: 12X10 (rectangle plugin) There is no night view for now. It will be updated later. And it supports the rectangle plugin. Please upgrade to version 1.12.26. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Jiuquan Satellite LaunchCenter
plugins.description: You can work with the rocket plugin made by zybsy which will be available in the store later! Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center also known as Dongfeng Aerospace City is Chinas oldest and largest comprehensive space launch base. It was founded on October 20 1958 and is located at the edge of the Badain Jaran Desert in Ejin Banner Inner Mongolia near Jiuquan City Gansu Province. The center covers an area of about 2800 square kilometers and has about 300 launch suitable days each year due to its climate. It is the only manned space launch site in China and mainly undertakes launches of low and medium orbit satellites high inclination orbit satellites returnable satellites and manned spacecraft. Key historic missions include Chinas first artificial satellite Dongfanghong 1 in 1970 first returnable satellite in 1975 first long range carrier rocket in 1980 first unmanned Shenzhou test spacecraft in 1999 and first manned spaceflight Shenzhou 5 in 2003. The center has complete facilities including rocket and spacecraft assembly test buildings launch pads and tracking and control systems. It is operated by the Peoples Liberation Army Aerospace Force and has completed hundreds of launch missions sending numerous satellites and manned spacecraft into space.

plugins.name: Kremlin walls | Fetris
plugins.description: The Kremlin walls are powerful defensive structures surrounding the Moscow Kremlin. They were built in the late 15th – early 16th centuries and are a striking example of Russian defensive architecture. The walls are approximately 2235 meters long and range in height from 5 to 19 meters, with a thickness of up to 3.5 meters at the base. The Kremlin walls are made of red brick and adorned with crenellations, giving them a distinctive appearance. Along the walls are 20 towers, each with its own unique architectural features. The most famous of these are the Spasskaya, Nikolskaya, and Senatskaya towers. The Kremlin walls served not only as protection for the Kremlin but also fulfilled a symbolic function, representing the power and independence of the state. Today, they are an important historical and cultural landmark of Moscow, attracting numerous tourists and being a part of Russia's historical heritage. Fetris

plugins.name: SG Maybank
plugins.description: Maybank Tower is a Grade A office skyscraper and the Singapore headquarters of Maybank, located at 2 Battery Road in the heart of Raffles Place Downtown Core Singapore. Designed by SYL Architects, it was completed in 2001 and replaced the former Malayan Bank Chambers. The building stands 175.26 meters tall with 32 above-ground floors and a six storey podium finished in granite and aluminum panels. The tower tapers towards the top, which is clad in double glazed blue reflective glass and aluminum curtain wall panels, and houses the Maybank logo. Its prime waterfront location behind the Merlion statue makes it a common backdrop in Singapore’s tourist postcards. It offers column free office spaces and is easily accessible via Raffles Place MRT station and multiple nearby bus stops, surrounded by abundant dining retail and business amenities.

plugins.name: Tour Saint-Jacques, Paris
plugins.description: The Tour Saint-Jacques (Saint James' Tower) stands 52 metres tall in the 4th arrondissement of Paris, France. Built between 1509 and 1523, it was the bell tower of the Church of Saint-Jacques-de-la-Boucherie, until that was demolished in 1797 amidst the French Revolution. However, the tower was retained, and today it serves as a beautiful example of the Flamboyant Gothic style, lying in a small square to which it gives its name. This plugin contains a recreation of the Tour Saint-Jacques, though it is not perfectly accurate since I wanted to make it symmetrical (too lazy to make rotation frames). The building is a 1x1 landmark with 100 culture influence, costing 15000₮ to build and 100₮ per month to maintain. The build time is 14 days, to mirror the 14 years it took to build. It requires no water but some electricity, since night lighting is included, and doesn't require a road connection. The colour palette and scale is compatible with my Modular neoclassical building and Modular Baroque church plugins, if you wish to integrate it into builds with them. February 2026 update: added a more gold-coloured 'sandstone' variant and improved the night animation frame. Plugins used in the thumbnail: British road pack by myself, Tree pack by Miuku, People(Trees) by michaelbello123, Seigneur (medieval pack) by streeet, Diagonal Grass by User19397163914, and Tranzit: Plazas and Pathways by AndroxArev.

plugins.name: Apple Xinyi A13 Store
plugins.description: It is an Apple Store opened by Apple Inc. in Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan Province. It officially opened on June 15, 2019, and is the second Apple Store in Taiwan and Taipei City after Apple Taipei 101. It is also the 506th Apple Store in the world, the first independent street store in Taiwan, and the first flagship store in Taiwan. The name of the store is derived from the A13 plot in the Xinyi Planning Area where it is located. It belongs to the same plot as the Far Eastern Department Store Xinyi A13, which opened on December 25, 2019, behind its building. It is situated in the core area of the Xinyi business district. Compared with the design form of the new flagship store of Apple on Michigan Avenue in Chicago, the design of this building inherits that of the Apple Park Visitor Center, the headquarters of Apple. For example, the 20-foot-high glass curtain wall and wood of the same material as the Apple Park Visitor Center, as well as the interior walls and escalators, all use the same marble as the headquarters. The handleless escalator is made by cutting marble inwardly, which is also a replica of the original headquarters. The roof is designed in the form of a metal carbon fiber material MacBook upper cover back plate. The staircase leading to the first basement floor, each consisting of 13 steps, echoes the store name "A13" and is a hidden surprise in the building design of this store. In addition, the Apple Xinyi A13 outdoor landscaping incorporates a large number of local imagery. The concept of the black boulder at the center of its pool is derived from the basalt of Penghu. The inspiration for the occasional water mist in the pool comes from the morning dust and fog in Taiwan. The trees planted around are Taiwanese camphor trees, which are very characteristic of the local area of Taiwan. size: 6X6 The nighttime scene texture has been reset by Rong. The price is uniformly set at 31 diamonds Rong & H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Masjid Agung Demak
plugins.description: The Masjid Agung Demak is a landmark of Indonesian Islamic heritage, established in the 15th century by Raden Patah as the spiritual center of the first Islamic kingdom in Java. Renowned for its association with the Wali Songo (the Nine Saints), the mosque is a masterpiece of cultural synthesis, featuring a traditional three-tiered Javanese roof instead of a conventional dome to represent the stages of spiritual growth. Supported by the legendary Saka Guru pillars and housing the historic Lawang Bledheg (Door of Thunder), the site remains a vital center for pilgrimage and a testament to the early spread of Islam across the archipelago.

plugins.description: The Geological Museum of Bandung is a historic and educational landmark located in Bandung, West Java, originally established in 1928 during the Dutch colonial era. It houses a vast and significant collection of geological specimens, ranging from rocks, minerals, and meteorites to prehistoric fossils, including a famous replica of the "Java Man" (Pithecanthropus erectus) skull. Serving as a center for both research and geo-tourism, the museum provides visitors with a comprehensive insight into the history of the Earth, natural disasters, and the rich geological evolution of the Indonesian archipelago.

plugins.description: Tongling Museum is located in the east bank of West Lake Wetland Park, No. 1506 Babao Road, Tongguan District, Tongling City, Anhui Province. The new Tongling Museum has been open free of charge since December 12, 2014, with a total area of 90 mu and a building area of 20,000 square meters, with a total investment of 260 million yuan. The museum is a local comprehensive museum, the national secondary museum. As of 2022, Tongling Museum has more than 12,049 pieces of collections, 903 pieces/sets of precious cultural relics, and the total number of annual visitors is 93,900, including 15 first-level collections, 27 second-level collections and 498 third-level collections. Its main function is to carry various exhibition halls such as copper culture exhibition and Tongling Regional culture Exhibition, as well as cultural relics collection, research, publicity and education. The shape of Tongling City Museum is built on the design prototype of the bronze ware unearthed in Tongling -- Spring and Autumn animal ear bird pattern. plugins.name: The Westpoint
plugins.description: China Merchants Group The Westpoint, also known as the Office of the Central People's Government in Hong Kong, is a skyscraper located on Hong Kong Island's West Repulse Bay. Its address is 160 Nathan Road. It backs onto Des Voeux Road West and is just one street away from the West District Police Station. The Westpoint was developed by the China Merchants Group and designed by Ho Si-yi Architect. It was completed in 1999 and stands at a height of 187.5 meters, with a total of 42 floors. The spherical viewing platform is located on the 42nd floor, and the 41st floor houses 4 suites of offices. The main feature of the exterior of The Westpoint is its spherical structure on the top, making it one of the landmarks of Sai Ying Pun. The front entrance of the centre is on the north side, and the south entrance faces Tse Fuk Chau Road tramway. The entrance lobby is on the top floor, and the basement is equipped with a parking lot. The front entrance has a flagpole and a gate, and the front area is planted with flowers. It is the location of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Therefore, it is commonly known as the "Liaison Office Building". size: 4X5 (rectangle plugin) There is no night view for now. It will be updated later. And it supports the rectangle plugin. Please upgrade to version 1.12.26. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Suzhou International Finance
plugins.description: Suzhou International Finance Center Suzhou International Finance Center is a prominent landmark skyscraper that defines the skyline of Suzhou, a renowned historical and modern city in eastern China. Nestled at No.409 East Suzhou Avenue, it takes pride in its prime location at the heart of the East Lake CBD in Suzhou Industrial Park, a hub brimming with economic vitality and innovation. Boasting a total construction area of 382,900 square meters, the building is a marvel of contemporary architecture, with its sleek, towering structure reflecting the city’s blend of tradition and modernity. As a large-scale multi-functional complex, it seamlessly integrates high-end Grade A office spaces, a luxury five-star hotel, a high-end shopping mall, and premium serviced apartments. The office area attracts a host of domestic and international financial institutions, multinational corporations, and tech enterprises, creating a vibrant ecosystem for business collaboration. The hotel offers top-notch accommodation and catering services, while the shopping mall features a curated selection of luxury brands, gourmet restaurants, and entertainment facilities, catering to the diverse needs of business elites, tourists, and local residents. More than just a building, Suzhou International Finance Center serves as a powerful engine driving the economic development of Suzhou and the surrounding region. It strengthens the city’s position as a key financial and business center in the Yangtze River Delta, while also becoming a popular destination for visitors who want to admire the city’s modern charm and take in panoramic views from its upper floors.

Nothing Beyond Infinity - January 2026 Update! Some of you guys really surprised me by somehow messing with values, even converting them to scientific notation. I've added reset buttons for you, so feel free to poke around! Yeah, that's all. I haven't returned to plugin creation, I just have a little free time left this evening. Cya! This time, the fog is literally FULLY editable, from color to view range, so be sure to look in the settings. plugins.description: DISCLAIMER: THIS PLUGIN MAY CAUSE FLOODING (EN) DISCLAIMER: PLUGIN INI BISA MEMBUAT BANJIR (ID) Palm Oil Tree Industry Plugin Bring the economic power and environmental challenge of the palm oil industry to your city! This plugin isn't just about building factories, it is a simulation of supply chains and sustainability. ## Features Palm Oil Plantation: Decorate your landscape with realistic palm oil trees. They are the backbone of your industry, but be careful extensive planting comes with risks. Each plantation has a chance to trigger local flooding. It's small, but never zero! Palm Oil Factories (Tiers 1-3): Process your harvest in specialized industrial facilities. Available in three tiers to scale with your city's needs: 1. Tier 1: Employs 500 workers 2. Tier 2: Employs 1,000 workers 3. Tier 3: Employs 1,900 workers ## Key Mechanics 1. Supply Chain Ratio: You can't cheat the system! Every single factory requires 4 Palm Oil Plantations to sustain it. If you don't have enough trees, you can't build the factory. 2. Sustainability Check: If you cut down your plantations, your supply chain will crumble. If the ratio drops below the requirement, your newest factories will be automatically shut down and removed. 3. Proximity Bonus: Factories must be built within 30 tiles of a plantation to ensure operational efficiency. Balance profit with nature and manage your resources carefully to build a thriving Palm Oil empire! ## Update Notes 12/01/2026: - Lowering the chance of flooding in the plantation - Update the plantation description - Update manifest ## Disclaimer - This plugin was created using AI assistance. - THIS PLUGIN MAY CAUSE FLOODING.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
DISCLAIMER: THIS PLUGIN MAY CAUSE FLOODING (EN)
DISCLAIMER: PLUGIN INI BISA MEMBUAT BANJIR (ID)

Palm Oil Tree Industry Plugin

Bring the economic power and environmental challenge of the palm oil industry to your city! This plugin isn't just about building factories, it is a simulation of supply chains and sustainability.

## Features
Palm Oil Plantation:
Decorate your landscape with realistic palm oil trees. They are the backbone of your industry, but be careful extensive planting comes with risks. Each plantation has a chance to trigger local flooding. It's small, but never zero!

Palm Oil Factories (Tiers 1-3):
Process your harvest in specialized industrial facilities. Available in three tiers to scale with your city's needs:
1. Tier 1: Employs 500 workers
2. Tier 2: Employs 1,000 workers
3. Tier 3: Employs 1,900 workers


## Key Mechanics
1. Supply Chain Ratio: You can't cheat the system! Every single factory requires 4 Palm Oil Plantations to sustain it. If you don't have enough trees, you can't build the factory.
2. Sustainability Check: If you cut down your plantations, your supply chain will crumble. If the ratio drops below the requirement, your newest factories will be automatically shut down and removed.
3. Proximity Bonus: Factories must be built within 30 tiles of a plantation to ensure operational efficiency.

Balance profit with nature and manage your resources carefully to build a thriving Palm Oil empire!

## Update Notes
12/01/2026:
- Lowering the chance of flooding in the plantation
- Update the plantation description
- Update manifest

## Disclaimer
- This plugin was created using AI assistance.
- THIS PLUGIN MAY CAUSE FLOODING.

Changsha Shimao World Financial Center
A 343-meter super high-rise landmark nestled in the heart of Changsha Furong CBD, it sits at the prime "Golden Cross" junction of Wuyi Avenue and Furong Middle Road—two of Changsha’s busiest and most prosperous thoroughfares. Adjacent to Exit 1 of Furong Square Metro Station, the building boasts exceptional transportation accessibility, linking seamlessly to the city’s public transit network. As Hunan Province’s second-tallest skyscraper, it spans a total construction area of around 227,000 square meters, integrating high-end office spaces, luxury commercial facilities, and top-tier supporting services. Its architectural design cleverly blends traditional Chinese landscape aesthetics with modern engineering techniques, embodying the unique charm of Changsha as a city where nature and urban vitality coexist harmoniously.

plugins.name: HongKong IFC
plugins.description: Hello everyone, this is Adgek. This is my second uploaded plugin: Two International Finance Centre (IFC) in Hong Kong. Hong Kong's Two IFC stands at a height of 412 meters with 88 floors, making it the second tallest building in Hong Kong. Designed by the architectural firm Cesar Pelli & Associates, the building takes the classic form of an obelisk, serving as a beacon in Hong Kong’s skyline and marking the entrance to Victoria Harbour. The tower's structure gradually tapers as it rises, culminating in a sculptural crown. Its open design draws the sky itself into the pinnacle, dematerializing part of the architectural form at its highest point. When the nightscape lights illuminate the tower crown each evening, it becomes visible from miles away, welcoming people to the gateway of Victoria Harbour. The building's façade is clad in reflective glass panels and pearl-silver mullions, allowing the tower to glow warmly against the backdrop of the mountains and the city, softening its exterior appearance. The design of the entire building aligns with the spirit of Victoria Harbour, blending seamlessly with the surrounding high-rises and natural beauty, making it an indispensable part of Hong Kong’s skyline. It features nighttime animations. I hope you all enjoy it.

plugins.name: Guangzhou R&F Yingkai Square
plugins.description: R&f Yingkai Plaza is located in the center of Zhujiang New District, Guangzhou. It is a multi-functional building that represents Guangzhou as a first-tier metropolis. The simple yet recognizable form was inspired by the various types of bamboo widely distributed locally. Standing at 296 meters tall, the entire building features asymmetrical openings and the pulsating vertical lines on the curtain wall, creating a visually dynamic effect. The stripes press against each other as they move upwards, and the dense lines of the base enhance the sense of solemnity. The Park Hyatt Guangzhou occupies the top floor of the building, with office buildings beneath it and the subway connected underground. As the building encapsulates all its functions in such a single form of expression, the design is mainly created in response to the environment. The square tower volume respects the bold geometric lines of the block grid. The gathering language formed by the corner carvings emphasizes the unique views at different heights, facing the street-facing buildings and extending diagonally towards the nearby central green space and the Pearl River Delta. The building is closely related to the urban life of the surrounding people, combining closeness with the experience of a high-end hotel. The hotel's sudden descent design and orderly arrival at the ground are carefully designed features. Through the warm color palette emphasized by sculptures, it gives people a sense of calm. The representative rooftop garden is located on the 70th floor and also offers a panoramic view. It is a warm and welcoming dining and leisure venue. size:5X5 It already has a night view. H3DY1OG0S.(night scene materials: Rong; Building glass curtain wall materials: Qingshihuang; Rooftop detail materials: corax)

plugins.description: The MUDA Architects originates from the idea of “a book falling from the sky”, and the shape of book is engaged with the architectural form to visualize the metaphor. Visitors are expected to step into the architectural space and get immersed into the tranquility to develop a positive self-talk and a journey of self-discovery. To create an appealing waterfront space, the project starts with a 12m*40m rectangular plane foundation located on the east lake shore of Xinglong Lake Southwest Bay Area. Meanwhile, the roof also cooperates with the water ripples in order to extend the wavy feature to the architecture and blend in the natural environment. The architecture is linearly expanded to conform with the site and connect with the lake. The glass curtain wall is installed to be partially subaqueous as the waterfront façade of the bookstore. plugins.name: Facades for concrete bases
plugins.description: A set of facades to restyle the concrete bases under the buildings on slopes as brick walls, street level entrances or commercial/storage spaces. The facades have railings on top for the safety of your denizens. Contains 3 styles sets: plain brick walls, arched walls (for old/formal buildings), half bricks/half concrete walls (for a more industrial/modern look). Each is available in two sizes to cover either one-story or two-story tall bases. The half concrete version blends in with the plain concrete bases so may it be used on taller bases too (the concrete half is copied from the in-game concrete bases: credit to Lobby/Theo) To use them, just draw them around the base you want to restyle. The facades will adapt to slopes, but you need to pick the correct height (H1 or H2) for each piece. Includes night lights/winter frames (where applicable) and custom streetlights, positioned at the edge of the tile, so they won’t be in the way of the street level openings. The streetlights are diagonal roads compatible and can be used on their own. Notes: This is decorative only! It is fence-based so it won’t consume any space but will not add any worker/inhabitant/influence. The left facing and right facing frames are often different (though on the same theme) to add some variety without having too many versions. If you use them on auto-built zones, you may need to update/rebuild them from time to time as the buildings change size. They are not meant/designed to be used stand-alone, they will look like theatre flats without a building behind. If you are looking for castle/city walls, this is not it.
