plugins.name: Berlin S+U Bahn
plugins.description: Hello everyone! It's me SomeGermanGuy aka. Kein Name and i got a great plugin for you! It's called Berlin S+U Bahn, because it contains 4 subway trains (U Bahnen) and 4 S Bahn trains from my city Berlin. The S Bahn is a very important public transport system next to the U Bahn (subway), tram and busses. The U Bahn (subway) contains the actual series of A3, G, HK and IK. The S Bahn contains the series BR 480, BR 481, BR 483, BR 484 and BR 485. You only can find these trains here in the capital city of germany: Berlin. To use my plugin first place the S+U Bahn rails and then the stations. Now you can set a route for the trains! I hope you enjoy this plugin and i wish you all a great time! 1.1: Corrected texture mistake by bridges. 1.2: Corrected missing shadows by stations and changed texts by stations. 1.3: Added two new trains and corrected minor texture mistake. 1.4: Finally after a long time a new big update! It contains a new S Bahn, new roofs, which are an extension of the in game ones, traffic light and new cool rails! There are now single rails for my S+U Bahn and for the in game ones too! (Note that they don't work as one, there are just optical.) Thanks for Lobby by helping me with some problems! 1.5: Now my trains have routes. Due to the new transportation extension! (Note that they now work as trains as it's not possible in another way right now.) 1.6: Sorry my mistake. Forgot to change the json for the rails... 1.7: Finally the trains now work as intended! They are an self reliant transportation system and not trains anymore.

plugins.name: Citigroup Center
plugins.description: Citigroup Center, located in Midtown Manhattan, is one of New York’s most recognizable skyscrapers. Completed in 1977, the tower stands out with its distinctive slanted top and bold modernist design. Rising about 915 feet, it features a sleek aluminum façade and clean vertical lines. One of its most unusual engineering features is the massive stilts at its base, which elevate the building above street level and create a dramatic open plaza. Inside, the tower hosts offices, a retail concourse, and direct access to public transit. Its appearance and structural innovations have made it an iconic part of the Manhattan skyline.

plugins.name: Tianjin Gaoyin 117
plugins.description: Tianjin 117 Building is a super high-rise office building project launched by Hong Kong Goldin Group in response to the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games in Tianjin, China. Construction started in September 2008 and the top was completed in 2015. But after 2015, Gaoyin Group's financial crisis, Tianjin 117 building project was forced to terminate. In addition, under the double blow of the COVID-19 epidemic and the sharp contraction of China's real estate economy, the 117 building in Tianjin fell into a 10-year shutdown period. In the spring of 2025, the Chinese government ordered to take over the project, with Cinda and China Construction Third Bureau undertaking the financial and construction tasks. The project is expected to be completed and opened to the public in 2027. The plug-in is based on the completed renderings of Tianjin 117 Building

plugins.name: One Liberty Plaza
plugins.description: One Liberty Plaza is a prominent office skyscraper located in Lower Manhattan, New York City. The building stands 54 floors tall and is known for its sleek, black steel façade and modernist architectural style. It was completed in 1972 and originally built for U.S. Steel, which reflects its strong, industrial appearance. The structure covers an entire city block and has a very geometric, clean, and powerful look that stands out among the surrounding buildings. Despite being close to the World Trade Center, One Liberty Plaza survived the events of September 11, 2001, though it sustained damage. Today, it remains one of the key commercial buildings in the area, home to many large financial and business firms. The building represents strength, resilience, and the financial power of New York City.

plugins.name: The Cenotaph, London
plugins.description: The Cenotaph is the national war memorial of the United Kingdom, located on the Strand, Westminster, London. Erected in 1920, it was dedicated to the fallen of Great Britain and her Empire during the First World War and later the Second World War. It is a cenotaph (empty tomb) made of Portland stone, with 6 flags flanking its sides - on the east, the White Ensign, the Union Jack, and the Blue Ensign; and on the west, the RAF Ensign, the Union Jack, and the Red Ensign. This plugin's recreation of it is a 1x1 landmark with rotation frames and culture influence, and it has a base as an upgrade which you can add by clicking on it. There is also a version without flags, if you want to use it in more nationally-neutral builds. This plugin also includes a recreation of the Monument to the Women of World War II. This memorial, also located on the Strand (outside the Cabinet Office) was erected in 2005 in commemoration of the efforts of British women during the Second World War. Again, this plugin object is rotation-aware, has culture influence, and can be upgraded to add a base.

plugins.name: Leatop plaza
plugins.description: The Leatop Plaza development answered a call for the completion of a new gateway at the north end of Zhujiang New Town, a central business district in the Tianhe District of Guangzhou, China. The result is a simple, bold, clear, and elegant shape that becomes an emblematic tower, with a crisp geometry crowned by a sharply sloped roof. The glass layers of the façade create a sculptural image, as if cut from a block of ice. The sloped lobby and roof follow the building’s continuous structural bracing, giving the tower a precise and distinctive image. The simple square plan is surrounded by landscaped space that integrates with the urban fabric. The dramatic glazed lobby is mimicked by a glazed sky garden at the upper extent of the building, offering an exclusive feature for its occupants. Meanwhile, the shingled façade accentuates the verticality of the tower and provides exterior shading, while the functional plan and efficient braced-tube structure minimize material usage. Combined with other environmental management strategies, Leatop Plaza achieved the first LEED certification in southeast China. Its memorable, minimal form soon became a landmark, ushering in subsequent development in the surrounding area. ——Jahn size:4x4 It already has a night view. H3DY1OG0S.(night scene materials: Rong)

plugins.name: Barangay Pack
plugins.description: The Pack is back so Barangayan na! (The word barangayan na is a playful term that means filing a complaint with the barangay hall between quarrelling parties or about certain disputes.) Barangay is a Tagalog word that originally meant boat during the precolonial philippine kingdoms or polities, It is still uncertain whether this is the origin of the modern use of barangay as the smallest political division in the Philippine government. A barangay is headed by a Barangay Captain and composed of seven barangay councilors (kagawad). Supporting them are the barangay justice committee (lupon) and the barangay watchmen (tanod). The Philippines is divided into many barangays, which are then grouped into towns, cities, or districts. Barangays vary greatly in population some of the smallest have fewer than 10 residents, while the largest have more than 100,000 people, nearly as many as a city. This system has its critics, but many also believe the barangay should be retained. The content of this plug-in features the different types of houses found in barangays, which often display a mix of architectural styles. This mixture is usually based on the preferences of the residents rather than a single, uniform architectural design. Contents of the Pack Plugin: Barangay Houses, 1x1 - 10 Structures, Barangay Houses on Stilts, 1x1 - 5 Structures, Barangay Docks, 1x1 - 1 Structure, Barangay Stilts Decoration, 1x1 - 1 Structure. I am Salonga, a Tagalog from the City of Navotas in the Philippines! This plugin may not be perfect or flawless, but I created it with a smile on my face.

plugins.name: Zhejiang I.T.F. Building
plugins.description: The International Trade Finance Building is located in Hangzhou, an eastern city of China. It serves as the new headquarters of Zhejiang International Trade Group, bringing together six units of the group and its member companies in one office location. The design concept of the building is based on the scale analysis of the urban planning of its plot. The project site is located on Fuchun Road, just a stone's walk from the Qiantang River. The public green space in front of the plot establishes a connection with the riverside landscape and echoes the surrounding skyscraper scenic line. The south facade of the building facing the Qiantang River has a glass slit, fully facing the green space and the river view. The floor plan of the building is based on regular square geometry. The outer edge of the building's outline is slightly inclined, and the corners are arc-shaped. The 170-meter-tall tower ranks among the tallest buildings in China with natural stone facades, thanks to its natural stone facade divided by vertical pile-shaped structures and horizontal window eave components. As the wind load on the facade increases with the height of the building, this design imposes certain restrictions on the building's height. In addition, light bands are integrated between the pilasters on the facade, illuminating the gleaming appearance of the tower in the afterglow of the setting sun, further emphasizing the design concept of vertical lines on the building's facade. ——GMP size:5x5 It already has a night view. H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Ber-Months Pack
plugins.description: Ber-Months is a term used by Filipinos to describe the Christmas season, which begins in September and lasts until December covering the months that end in “-ber.” However, the season is often extended until January with the Feast of the Three Kings. During this period, Christmas songs, decorations, and events begin to fill the atmosphere. Christmas in the Philippines is joyfully celebrated by various ethnic groups such as the Tagalog, Kapampangan, Bisaya, Ilocano, and many others, making it colorful and vibrant. Each province has its own unique way of celebrating. One of the most iconic symbols is the parol (known in archaic Tagalog as paritaan). This plugin highlights the parol lanterns of Pampanga, the Kapampangan people, who live north of Manila, the capital. Contents of the pack plugin: Bamboo Christmas Tree, 1x1 – 1 Building Lubena Parol (Cross Shape), 1x1 – 2 Buildings Parol (Circle Shape), 1x1 – 10 Buildings Christmas Booth (Booth), 1x1 – 2 Buildings Parol Asan (Fish Shape), 1x1 – 2 Buildings I am Salonga, a Tagalog from the City of Navotas in the Philippines! This plugin may not be perfect or flawless, but I created it with a smile on my face.

plugins.name: Dune Art Museum
plugins.description: "On a stretch of sand in Changli County, North China's Bohai Bay, known as the Gold Coast, OPEN has designed a hidden art gallery that resembles a mysterious cave hidden beneath the sand dunes. Coastal dunes have formed naturally over long periods of time and through the passage of wind and sand, and have been solidified by the deep roots of native low shrubs. The location of the museum under the sand dune is both a tribute to nature and a form of protection: because of the existence of the Sand Dune Museum, the sand dune will never be artificially "bulldozed", thus maintaining the fragile dune ecosystem accumulated over thousands of years. Inspired by the children's game of digging sand at the beach, the architects attempted to "dig" in the sand dunes to create a number of different and interconnected "caves" - the most primitive form of human habitation and the earliest place for artistic creation. A series of cell-like continuous Spaces constitute the rich functions of the Dune Museum, including exhibition halls of various sizes, reception halls and cafes." ——Arch Daily size:5X5 It already has a night view H3DY1OG0S.

plugins.name: Yokohama Landmark Tower
plugins.description: Yokohama Landmark Tower is a high-rise complex in Yokohama, Japan. Construction began on March 20, 1990 and the building opened on July 16, 1993. The tower building has 70 floors and is 296.33 m tall, making it the third tallest skyscraper in Japan as of 2023. The building contains a five-star hotel called “Yokohama Royal Park Hotel” which occupies floors 49–70. The lower 48 floors contain shops, restaurants, clinics, and offices. On the 69th floor there is an observatory, Sky Garden, from which one can see a 360-degree view of the city and, on clear days, Mount Fuji. Size: 8x8 I hope you like it!

plugins.description: The library is located in a resort community along the coast of China's Bohai Bay, about a three-hour drive from Beijing. plugins.name: Place des Vosges, Paris
plugins.description: The Place des Vosges is a square in Paris, France that is lined with 17th-century townhouses of red brick and Lutetian limestone. Constructed between 1605 and 1612 during the reign of Henri IV, it was originally called the Place Royale, before French Republican government renamed it after the department of Vosges in 1800. Today, it lies predominantly in the 4th arrondissement in the Marais district, with a marble equestrian statue of Louis XIII in the centre surrounded by four fountains. This pack contains: - Place des Vosges category in Landmarks - Hôtel (townhouse) building (2x2) - Pavillon (pavilion) building (2x2) - Statue of Louis XIII, with 2 variants for alignment (1x1, 2x2) - Fontaine (fountain), also with 2 variants for alignment (1x1, 2x2) All pieces are rotation-aware (except for the fontaine, which is 4-way symmetrical), and the buildings have night animations. Other plugins used in the thumbnail: Tree pack by Miuku, Decoration Set Props by D Monk, Some SC4 Fan's Trees (v2) by ur_sc4_guy, Max's props expansion by THEMAX, Crosswalks by dnswodn, and Diagonal Grass by User19397163914.

plugins.name: Admiralty Arch, London
plugins.description: The Admiralty Arch is a neoclassical landmark located in Westminster, London, United Kingdom. Completed in 1912 under the reign of King Edward VII, it was dedicated to the late Queen Victoria and has served as offices for various branches of HM Government (including, initially, the Admiralty). Its arches allow pedestrian and road traffic to flow through, connecting Trafalgar Square and the Mall. This plugin contains a 7x7 recreation of the Admiralty Arch (though it's not exact since I tried to fit it more nicely with the TheoTown grid). By clicking on it, you can add various upgrades, including roads that are compatible with Mew's Advanced Road (credit to Mew for these textures). The building has basic night animation but no rotation frames yet. It is quite expensive, costing 1.2 million ₮ to build and 2000₮ a month to maintain, but it gives lots of culture influence (250) and some management influence (50) as well. As a bonus, I've also added a 3x3 TTT dense residential based on the wings of the Admiralty Arch.

plugins.name: Old Joe, Birmingham
plugins.description: Old Joe, formally the Joseph Chamberlain Memorial Clock Tower, is a clock and bell tower located in the Edgbaston campus of the University of Birmingham, England, United Kingdom. At 100m (or 110m according to some sources) in height, it has been the tallest freestanding clock tower in the world since its completion in 1908. This plugin contains rotation frames and a night animation. The tower is a 1x1 building in the Landmarks category, costing 25000₮ to build (mirroring the real-life cost of £25000) and 150₮ monthly to maintain. It requires electricity but no water, and provides influences of culture and a little bit of high education.

plugins.descriptionHtml:
This tool will be helped for mobile users to move the city view from end to end easily.

Plugin Settings:
1. Show Button: to de/activating the plugin.
2. Auto Hide: to de/activating the auto hide feature.

4. Opposite Position to Sidebar: if enabled, the button position will be on the other side from sidebar.
5. Show In Build Mode: if enabled, the button will not be hidden in the build mode.
6. Reset: to reset this plugin settings.
7. Minimum Alpha When Hiding the Button: the minimum alpha of the button hide when unused, the 0 value will be totally unseen.
8. Button Hiding Timeout: to set the timeout in millisecond to hide the button when unused.
9. Movement Speed: to set the speed of view movements.
10. Button Size: to set the button size.
11. Button X/Y Position: to set the button positions.
12. Analog Background Color (Red/Green/Blue): to set colors of the button background.
13. Analog Button Color (Red/Green/Blue): to set colors of the button.

plugins.name: Dugald Stewart Monument
plugins.description: The Dugald Stewart Monument stands on Calton Hill, overlooking the city of Edinburgh, Scotland. It was commissioned by the Royal Society of Edinburgh in 1830 as a memorial to the eponymous Scottish philosopher and mathematician, Dugald Stewart (1753–1828). Designed by Scottish architect William Henry Playfair, it was completed in 1831 and Category A listed in 1966. The monument, featuring nine Corinthian columns around an urn, was based upon the ancient Choragic Monument of Lysicrates in Athens, Greece. Category: Landmark Size: 1x1 Price: 5000₮ Monthly price: 5₮ Influences: 50 culture Night animation: yes

I hope you like this plugin! (All night views are included)

plugins.name: JP Residential Buildings Pack
plugins.description: Hello , this is me , RockFort , and I'm thrilled to present you the new Japan Residential Buildings Pack ! This pack contains 230+ Japanese-themed T , TT and TTT residential buildings for your city , from old historic traditional houses to suburban homes , apartement complexes , low - rise buildings , and large-scale apartement towers , as well 4 custom zones ! This new update ( 2.5.0 ) is a small update that focus mostly on adding mid rise apartement buildings largely requested by the communauty . ---CONTENTS--- This pack includes : - Ton of 1x1 , 2x2 , and 3x3 , 4x4 and 5x5 appartement buildings for T and TT buildings , and a few TTT - 2 4x4 , 2 5x5 , 2 6x6 large appartements buildings - 8 1x1 low - rise buildings , 3 2x2 low - rise buildings - Around 50 1x1 and 2x2 modern suburban houses - 20+ 1x1 and 2x2 traditional style houses - a bunch of modular buildings - 3 1x1 corner buildings in all directions - 4 custom dedicated zones to control your zoning ( traditional housing zone , suburban housing zone , low rise only zone , and Japanese Residential zone ) which appears in your zoning tab - 20+ decorative tiles such as zen gardens , car parking , community garden to give life to your cities Night and snow graphics aren't included. More informations and pics are available on the forum post dedicated to this pack in the TheoTown forum , along with a free version ! Credits Kingtut 101 for bushes graphics , some of the roof props and some trees ; Credits Bokoblo for making some buildings variations IMPORTANT : If you used the old versions of the pack , please remove the old version from your plugin folder and replace it with this new pack if you don't want to have issues when launching the game ( aka id already in use ) . If you used the 2022 version of the JPPack ( 2.3.2 ) before and want to keep the commercial buildings , I uploaded the commercial buildings in their separate pack . Look at my profile to find it . Have fun and enjoy this pack !

plugins.name: Tengwang Pavilion
plugins.description: Tengwang Pavilion, located in Yanjiang Road, Donghu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, is located on the east bank of Ganjiang River and at the intersection of Ganjiang River and Fuhe River. It is a landmark building in Nanchang City and a symbol of Yuzhang ancient civilization. Built in the fourth year of Yonghui of the Tang Dynasty (653), it was built by Li yuanying, the younger brother of Li Shimin, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, when he was the governor of Hongzhou in the south of the Yangtze River. The existing building was rebuilt in 1985. It is famous for the Preface to Tengwang Pavilion written by Wang Bo, a poet in the early Tang Dynasty. It is one of the four famous buildings in ancient China, together with Yueyang Yueyang Tower in Hunan Province and Wuhan Yellow Crane Tower in Hubei Province, known as the Three Famous Buildings in the South.
plugins.descriptionHtml: Tengwang Pavilion, located in Yanjiang Road, Donghu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, is located on the east bank of Ganjiang River and at the intersection of Ganjiang River and Fuhe River. It is a landmark building in Nanchang City and a symbol of Yuzhang ancient civilization. Built in the fourth year of Yonghui of the Tang Dynasty (653), it was built by Li yuanying, the younger brother of Li Shimin, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, when he was the governor of Hongzhou in the south of the Yangtze River. The existing building was rebuilt in 1985. It is famous for the Preface to Tengwang Pavilion written by Wang Bo, a poet in the early Tang Dynasty. It is one of the four famous buildings in ancient China, together with Yueyang Yueyang Tower in Hunan Province and Wuhan Yellow Crane Tower in Hubei Province, known as the Three Famous Buildings in the South.

plugins.name: Modular neoclassical building
plugins.description: Do you want to build a beautiful custom parliament? Cathedral? Town hall? Palace? Something else? Whatever the monument, this pack of modular neoclassical architecture should be an exquisite and timeless addition to your city. As per the name, the architecture is neoclassical or classical revivalist, with some Baroque influence as well. It is not entirely copied off of one place, but it is inspired by various structures including St Paul's Cathedral (London), the Panthéon (Paris), the Church of the Madeleine (Paris), and the U.S. Capitol Building (Washington). These structures can all be fairly faithfully recreated with this plugin. Contains: - 3x3 dome pieces - 3x3 building pieces - 1x3 building pieces - 1x3 portico pieces - 1x1 clock tower pieces - 1x1 colonnade pieces - 1x1 block pieces - All pieces contained in "Neoclassical" category under Public > Awards - 4+ variants for every piece Notes: - All pieces are effectively rotation-aware (though 4-way symmetrical pieces don't have separate rotation frames for simplicity). - Night frames included for the domes and clock towers only. - Snow frames are not included. - Domes cost 30,000 to build and 300 monthly to maintain. - Clock towers cost 10,000 to build and 100 monthly to maintain. - 3x3 building pieces cost 10,000 to build and 100 monthly to maintain. - All 1x3 pieces cost 3,000 to build and 30 monthly to maintain. - Colonnade and block pieces cost 1,000 to build and 10 monthly to maintain. - All pieces provide 100 park and culture influence. - All pieces do not require road. - Porticos and colonnades do not require power or water, but the other pieces do.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build a beautiful custom parliament? Cathedral? Town hall? Palace? Something else? Whatever the monument, this pack of modular neoclassical architecture should be an exquisite and timeless addition to your city.

As per the name, the architecture is neoclassical or classical revivalist, with some Baroque influence as well. It is not entirely copied off of one place, but it is inspired by various structures including St Paul's Cathedral (London), the Panthéon (Paris), the Church of the Madeleine (Paris), and the U.S. Capitol Building (Washington). These structures can all be fairly faithfully recreated with this plugin.

Contains:
- 3x3 dome pieces
- 3x3 building pieces

- Night frames included for the domes and clock towers only.

- Colonnade and block pieces cost 1,000 to build and 10 monthly to maintain.

plugins.name: TUGU GOLONG GILIG
plugins.description: This monument is to the north of the palace, being part of the philosophical axis that stretches from Mount Merapi, Tugu Golong Gilig, Yogyakarta Palace, Panggung Krapyak, and the South Sea. Because of its long shape and white color, the Dutch call it white paal (white pole). For this reason, to this day, the Golong Gilig Monument is sometimes still referred to as the Pal Putih Monument. This monument was built a year after Yogyakarta was founded, precisely in 1756. The initial shape of this building was a cylinder (golong) with a circle at the top (gilig), so it was known as the Golong Gilig Monument. The form of golong gilig means the spirit of unity between the people and their king. It is also a symbol of the Javanese philosophy of Manunggaling Kawula Gusti which not only means the unity of the people with the rulers, but also the unity of humans with the will of the Creator. sorry if the results of the plugin are not satisfactory, God willing, I will try to make a good plugin, btw this is my first plugin hahaha 2x2 1x build Shading by tacel

plugins.name: JP City Halls Pack
plugins.description: Hello , this is me , RockFort , and I'm thrilled to give you my new plugin : a pack of Japanese - themed city halls ! This pack allows you to build 2 city halls inspired by the city halls of Gotsu and Kurume , Japan . I choosed to make these ones because I wanted to do some Japanese public buildings in order to fit with a Japanese-themed city . The Gotsu City Hall was a suggestion from @The_Real_Michael_1 in the ideas-for-plugins thread of the TheoTown forum . ~~~ The Gotsu City Hall is a 10x4 building in - game and provides some management ( 120 ) and a few park and culture influence . It is modulable and is splited into 2 3x3 parts and a 4x4 part . @wa64 made some edits to the building of the original pack , along with mirrored version of the building , which gives more life to it in my opinion . Great if you are looking for more details and more variety ! The Kurume City Hall is a 3x7 building in game and provides some management ( 180 ) and a few park and culture influence . It comes with 2 2x2 and one 3x3 pieces. Due to the repetitive design of the floors , I implemented animations in order to save some plugin space . You can find all the puzzle pieces in their own subcategories in your management tab . The ground is removed on all the buildings , allowing you to change the grounds underneath the buildings . ~~~ Night and snow graphics aren't included . Credits to Wa64 for making edits on the Gotsu City Hall and Theo&Lobby for the antennae graphics . Thanks for any advice / feedback / criticsm ! If you don't like my plugins, don't download them ! More info available in the forum thread ! IMPORTANT : If you were using the Gotsu City Hall previously ( with or without the Wa64 edits ) and want to have the new Kurume City Hall , please remove the GotsuCityHall.zip or you might end up having issues ( id already in use ! )

plugins.name: Cabinet of Ministers of Latvia
plugins.description: This is the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Latvia, which was dedicated to the 106th anniversary of Latvia's independence. The plugin was posted on my DS server on November 18th. Thank you for your help Town Builder Pro! The construction of the building was initiated by the President of Latvia, Kārlis Ulmanis. It was built on the site of the former old Senate and Courthouse building (Miertiešu sapulces nams). Ravelin Square and Mazais Vērmanes dārzs were built over. The competition for the building project was won by Aleksandrs Klinklāvs, but the author of the final construction plan was Frīdrihs Skujiņš. The project was adopted at a meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers on September 29, 1936. The foundation stone of the building was laid on December 4, 1936 by the Latvian Minister of War Jānis Balodis, the foundation stone laying ceremony was opened by the Latvian Minister of Justice Hermanis Apsītis, and representatives of the justice departments from Lithuania and Estonia also participated in the ceremony. A stone and a parchment roll donated by representatives of the Estonian Minister of Justice were laid in the foundation. The first phase of construction of the building took place from 1936 to 1938 under the leadership of the contractor M. Vaitnieks. From 1938 to 1940, the Palace of Justice housed the Ministry of Justice together with its departments, the Senate of Latvia, the Chamber of Justice, the Council of Sworn Advocates, the Institute of Scientific Forensic Expertise and the Riga Land Registry Department. The number of courtrooms, offices and office spaces in the Palace of Justice reached 130. The Senate operated on the second floor of the building until 1940. In the Senate Hall there is an inscription by Kārlis Ulmanis: "One law — one justice for all!".

Ravelin Square and Mazais Vērmanes dārzs were built over. The competition for the building project was won by Aleksandrs Klinklāvs, but the author of the final construction plan was Frīdrihs Skujiņš. The project was adopted at a meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers on September 29, 1936.
The foundation stone of the building was laid on December 4, 1936 by the Latvian Minister of War Jānis Balodis, the foundation stone laying ceremony was opened by the Latvian Minister of Justice Hermanis Apsītis, and representatives of the justice departments from Lithuania and Estonia also participated in the ceremony. A stone and a parchment roll donated by representatives of the Estonian Minister of Justice were laid in the foundation. The first phase of construction of the building took place from 1936 to 1938 under the leadership of the contractor M. Vaitnieks.
From 1938 to 1940, the Palace of Justice housed the Ministry of Justice together with its departments, the Senate of Latvia, the Chamber of Justice, the Council of Sworn Advocates, the Institute of Scientific Forensic Expertise and the Riga Land Registry Department. The number of courtrooms, offices and office spaces in the Palace of Justice reached 130. The Senate operated on the second floor of the building until 1940. In the Senate Hall there is an inscription by Kārlis Ulmanis: "One law — one justice for all!".

plugins.name: HK M+ Museum
plugins.description: Night animation included. Designed by Herzog & de Meuron in collaboration with TFP Farrells and Arup, the building consists of a horizontal podium and a slender vertical tower, forming an inverted T shape. The expansive podium, elevated above the ground, houses 17,000 square meters of exhibition space, including 33 galleries, three cinemas, a multimedia center, learning spaces, and a rooftop garden with panoramic views of the harbor. The vertical tower accommodates the museum’s research center, offices, restaurants, and the M+ lounge on the 11th floor. An LED façade facing Victoria Harbour displays moving image artworks, visible from the West Kowloon Promenade and across the harbor on Hong Kong Island. The design allows visitors to enter from multiple points, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor spaces.

Good morning Mayor! I am glad to present the Version 1.1 Update to you my friends.
You can create your own shader by adjusting the parameters in the SIO IV Shader plugin!

Questions and Answers!
Q: Why the shader isn't working?
A: Please check your settings and make sure SIO Custom is enable.

1. Modified the line height of the UI, now it is shorter.

3. Added preset function, now you can save and load your adjustments easily.

The current parameters: exposure, contrast, color temperature, vibrance, saturation, brightness and season.

plugins.name: Vitra Fire Station
plugins.description: The Vitra Fire Station, designed by Zaha Hadid and completed in 1993, is an iconic example of deconstructivist architecture. Located in Weil am Rhein, Germany, this structure stands out with its bold, sculptural forms and dynamic lines. The building features a series of interlocking volumes that create a sense of movement, reflecting the energy of the fire service it houses. Its white concrete façade and angular rooflines contrast sharply with the surrounding landscape, embodying Hadid's innovative approach to form and space. This cars may run on normal roads for you to freely customize roads for them. I would recommend to give separate one way roads for them If you want a race track. Hi! I am Chuzruzzshimuzi,
I made a car racing expansion pack.
The most unique of this plugin is that, every car variant has MAXIMUM AND MINIMUM SPEED DIFFERENTLY. Car speeds of varieties are adjusted and balanced to have an actual scenarios on car racing competitions like on the tv or car racing games like overrunning, delaying, slow and blocking others.I enjoyed seeing every car can overrun others if they reached their max speed. This cars may run on normal roads for you to freely customize roads for them. I would recommend to give separate one way roads for them If you want a race track. Wide roads like 2by2 and very long around the city is best. Also, I made a road for them that prevents other normal cars to drive on it but service cars can run on to it. In exchange to have ability to place road decorations like traffic lights and road decors which are very useful. You will discover more features on your experiments. In Addition, I made an animated fans that are very cheerful.For other thing, If you want a starting line, the PLUGIN CREATOR CHOGGOBA has unique horizontal traffic lights as alternative and are very useful for this plugin. Road decorations are already available from other creators. So, I didn't make any. I can promise that this is not boring, very interactive and entertaining. I hope that I don't fail your expectations. This is worth it and most of all, have fun.

Note: You may try it first in the sandbox mode. This is an expensive entertainment of rich countries.

plugins.name: Dynamic Clouds
plugins.description: This plugin introduces cloud movement that dynamically adjusts based on your city's view and scale, adding an extra layer of realism and visual appeal to your cities. Features: 1. Dynamic Cloud Movement: - Movement: Clouds move from the right side, to the left side of the screen. - Speed Adjustment: Cloud movement adjusts to match the speed of your city, keep in mind that the movement of the clouds is slow. - Horizontal (X-axis) movements keep clouds within their range, while vertical (Y-axis) movements adjust cloud positions to a new view. - Fast movements of the screen cause the clouds disappear and reappear new clouds. 2. Adaptive Cloud Generation: - Automatic Reappearance: Clouds disappear when out of view and automatically reappear within the visible range of the city. - Performance: The number of clouds adjusts automatically based on the city size. * Regardless of plot size, only 8 clouds are visible at time for performance optimization. 3. Visual Variety: - Appearance: Clouds vary in transparency and size, creating a visually diverse sky. * Keep in mind that there are only 4 frames, 2 large and 2 small clouds, for performance reasons. - Shadow Effects: Clouds have shadow effects. - Day/Night Compatibility: Clouds adjust to the day/night cycle. - Zoom Consideration: Clouds automatically become invisible when zoomed in too closely to avoid obstructing the view. - Cloud Scaling: The size of the clouds is adjusted slightly according to the zoom scale. 4. User Settings: - Enable/Disable Clouds: Toggle the cloud on or off through the Settings menu. Tested City Sizes: - Small: 0.10 km² - Medium: 0.41 km² - Big: 1.6 km² - Huge: 6.6 km² - Colossal: 15 km² - Giant: 26 km² - Even Bigger: 105 km² Credits: Special thanks to Jefri a.l for the cloud design.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
This plugin introduces cloud movement that dynamically adjusts based on your city's view and scale, adding an extra layer of realism and visual appeal to your cities.

Features:
1. Dynamic Cloud Movement:
- Movement: Clouds move from the right side, to the left side of the screen.
- Speed Adjustment: Cloud movement adjusts to match the speed of your city, keep in mind that the movement of the clouds is slow.
- Horizontal (X-axis) movements keep clouds within their range, while vertical (Y-axis) movements adjust cloud positions to a new view.
- Fast movements of the screen cause the clouds disappear and reappear new clouds.

2. Adaptive Cloud Generation:
- Automatic Reappearance: Clouds disappear when out of view and automatically reappear within the visible range of the city.
- Performance: The number of clouds adjusts automatically based on the city size.
* Regardless of plot size, only 8 clouds are visible at time for performance optimization.

3. Visual Variety:
- Appearance: Clouds vary in transparency and size, creating a visually diverse sky.
* Keep in mind that there are only 4 frames, 2 large and 2 small clouds, for performance reasons.
- Shadow Effects: Clouds have shadow effects.
- Day/Night Compatibility: Clouds adjust to the day/night cycle.
- Zoom Consideration: Clouds automatically become invisible when zoomed in too closely to avoid obstructing the view.
- Cloud Scaling: The size of the clouds is adjusted slightly according to the zoom scale.

4. User Settings:
- Enable/Disable Clouds: Toggle the cloud on or off through the Settings menu.

plugins.description: This plugin adds a 3x3 medieval styled hospital based on a medieval hospital in Goslar, Germany. Today the building, which is generally known by its German name 'Große Heilige Kreuz', still houses flats for retired people." This plugin was supposed to be a part of a pack of different buildings based on plugin suggestions in the discord server, but I wasn't really in the mood for drawing more buildings again so I decided to post this separately. plugins.name: Emergency road
plugins.description: An emergency lane, also known as a shoulder or hard shoulder, is a designated area alongside a roadway that serves as an extra lane for emergency vehicles and provides a safe space for vehicles to stop in case of breakdowns or emergencies. Here are some key points about an emergency lane: Purpose: The primary purpose of an emergency lane is to allow emergency vehicles (such as ambulances, fire trucks, and police cars) to pass through traffic congestion quickly. It also provides a safe area for drivers to stop if their vehicle breaks down or if they need to address an emergency situation. Location: Emergency lanes are typically located on the right side of the road (in countries where traffic flows on the right). They are separated from the main traffic lane by a solid white line. In some cases, emergency lanes may also be present on the left side of the road. Usage: Emergency Vehicles: Emergency vehicles use the emergency lane to bypass traffic and reach their destination faster. Breakdowns and Emergencies: If your vehicle breaks down or you encounter an emergency, move your vehicle to the emergency lane (if available) to avoid obstructing traffic. Turn on hazard lights and place warning triangles behind your vehicle. No Stopping or Parking: Emergency lanes are not for regular stopping or parking. Only use them during emergencies. Rules and Regulations: No Overtaking: Regular vehicles should not overtake other vehicles using the emergency lane. Exiting Safely: If you stop in the emergency lane, exit your vehicle on the side away from traffic. Be cautious when re-entering traffic. Speed Limit: Some areas may have a reduced speed limit in the emergency lane. Remember that emergency lanes are crucial for safety, so use them responsibly and only when necessary. Always follow local traffic laws and guidelines. 🚗🚒🚑 If you have any more questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask! 😊

plugins.name: National Gallery of Denmark
plugins.description: The National Gallery of Denmark (Statens Museum for Kunst) is the Danish national gallery, located in the centre of Copenhagen. The museum collects, registers, maintains, researches and handles Danish and foreign art dating from the 14th century to the present day. The museum's collections constitute almost 9,000 paintings and sculptures, approximately 240,000 works of art on paper as well as more than 2,600 plaster casts of figures from ancient times, the middle-ages and the Renaissance. Most of the older objects come from the Danish royal collection. The original museum building was designed by Vilhelm Dahlerup and G.E.W. Møller and built 1889–1896 in a Historicist Italian Renaissance revival style. Size: 4x12 (3 4x4 parts) I hope you like it!

plugins.name: 432 Avenue Park
plugins.description: 432 Park Avenue is a residential skyscraper at 57th Street and Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan in New York City, overlooking Central Park. The 1,396-foot-tall (425.5 m) tower was developed by CIM Group and Harry B. Macklowe and designed by Rafael Viñoly. A part of Billionaires' Row, 432 Park Avenue has some of the most expensive residences in the city, with the median unit selling for tens of millions of dollars. At the time of its completion in 2015, 432 Park Avenue was the third-tallest building in the United States and the tallest residential building in the world. As of 2023, it is the sixth-tallest building in the United States, the fifth-tallest building in New York City, and the third-tallest residential building in the world.

plugins.name: St. Mark's Campanile Tower
plugins.description: Update: - Upper area improved - Shadow rate slightly increased St Mark's Campanile (Italian: Campanile di San Marco, Venetian: Canpanièl de San Marco) is the bell tower of St Mark's Basilica in Venice, Italy. The current campanile is a reconstruction completed in 1912, the previous tower having collapsed in 1902. At 98.6 metres (323 ft) in height, it is the tallest structure in Venice and is colloquially termed "el paròn de casa" (the master of the house). It is one of the most recognizable symbols of the city. Located in Saint Mark's Square near the mouth of the Grand Canal, the campanile was initially intended as a watchtower to sight approaching ships and protect the entry to the city. It also served as a landmark to guide Venetian ships safely into harbour. Construction began in the early tenth century and continued sporadically over time as the tower was slowly raised in height. A belfry and a spire were first added in the twelfth century. In the fourteenth century the spire was gilded, making the tower visible to distant ships in the Adriatic. The campanile reached its full height in 1514 when the belfry and spire were completely rebuilt on the basis of an earlier Renaissance design by Giorgio Spavento. Historically, the bells served to regulate the civic and religious life of Venice, marking the beginning, pauses, and end of the work day; the convocation of government assemblies; and public executions. plugins.name: the Colossus of Rhodes
plugins.description: hello mi frends Today, I present to you my most challenging plugin to create. I bring you (a much larger version of) the Colossus of Rhodes. Please note that this is not a perfect replica; it's inspired by an image on the internet depicting what a new statue like this might look like if built in modern times. This statue was once one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, erected in Rhodes, Greece, around 280 B.C. It represented the sun god Helios, serving as a significant symbol for the island. However, in 226 B.C., an earthquake caused the statue to collapse, leading to its disappearance and making it one of the six wonders of the ancient world that, unfortunately, no longer exist. Does not include rotation aware. - Landmark - 3 pieces - 100 days to build each piece - Influences Culture and Religion - Total cost: around 25K - w/night animation (Sorry if it's not that good.) Oh, and I almost forgot, thanks to Lobby and Theotheoderich, for the little boat sprite.

It is located on the site of the World Trade Center's Twin Towers. The memorial is made up of two water mirrors with waterfalls, located in the same places as the old towers. Additionally, there are panels with the names of the more than 2,900 victims of the attacks, including the first responders who lost their lives. It is a place of tribute and reflection, remembering one of the most significant events in the history of the United States.

plugins.name: Firewatch Towers
plugins.description: A deco for your forests and mountains. It goes into the Services/Fire dept folder. This is a set of the 4 watch towers for an early fire detection in your forests. Nowadays they tend to be closed because of new techs in fire lookout like solar powered drones observing vast territories 24/7. The redundant firewatch towers are often offered for rent as an exotic tourist accomodation. I was inspired by the trailers to the pc game of the same name. I never played it, but it catched my imagination and I started to surf Inet for some real towers, which happened to look similar everywhere. These watch towers are occupied by the Men of the Firewatch on huge Barley Marlinsome bikes with a powerful 75 mkp (mega kitty power) motor easily dealing with very steep hills. Sometimes they go to check the folks in the nearest firebrigades. Men talk, you know. Tech info: Custom night animation. Each tower spawns her own unique biker targeting firebrigade buildings. A slight fire dep influence. No capability to fight fires (its just 1 man, cmon!). Its own category in the 'Fire dept.' folder. If I lived in America, I would definitely try to rent this for a night. Having a paintworth 360 degr panorama view with a cup of cofee and a roof above seems appealing.

plugins.name: St. Pancras station
plugins.description: Greetings, ladies and gentlemen. Today I will finally publish my MOST excellent, massive creation - St. Pancras Station. This plugin has been posted on my Discord server for a month now, but I just now found the time to post it here as well. This is a large railway station in the center of London. Built in the Victorian style, respectively - in the 1800s. Includes: 1. Small two-story buildings on the western side of the station; 2. Three-story buildings from the facade (with high roofs); 3. Variants of three-story houses with arches and loggias; 4. Building with two towers on the extreme left side of the facade; 5. Corner buildings for small and three-story (as in the facade) buildings(In fact, there are no corner buildings in reality, but I decided to add them anyway); 6. Tall building with elements of the Dutch Renaissance on the facade, as well as a tower (Located on the western side of the station); 7. And finally - a high clock tower at the corner of the station. There is no large building on the front side, but it may be added in the future. Cultural influences and night lighting are present in every building except the corner ones. This is all. I must say that I spent a lot of time and effort developing this plugin, so I will be very glad to hear your feedback in the comments. All the best.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Greetings, ladies and gentlemen.

Today I will finally publish my MOST excellent, massive creation - St. Pancras Station.

This plugin has been posted on my Discord server for a month now, but I just now found the time to post it here as well.

This is a large railway station in the center of London. Built in the Victorian style, respectively - in the 1800s.

Includes:

1. Small two-story buildings on the western side of the station;

2. Three-story buildings from the facade (with high roofs);

3. Variants of three-story houses with arches and loggias;

4. Building with two towers on the extreme left side of the facade;

5. Corner buildings for small and three-story (as in the facade) buildings(In fact, there are no corner buildings in reality, but I decided to add them anyway);

6. Tall building with elements of the Dutch Renaissance on the facade, as well as a tower (Located on the western side of the station);

7. And finally - a high clock tower at the corner of the station.

There is no large building on the front side, but it may be added in the future.

Cultural influences and night lighting are present in every building except the corner ones.

This is all. I must say that I spent a lot of time and effort developing this plugin, so I will be very glad to hear your feedback in the comments.

All the best.

plugins.name: Erin's Road Additions
plugins.description: A road additions set you can create better looking roads with! It comes with borderless and stackable roads as well as a sidewalk fence to be able to have a sidewalk only on one side of a borderless road. The main part of the plugin are the decoration pieces that can be combined together to create your desired road look. Some of which have been added as roads to easily drag over larger areas, while decoration pieces can add the smaller details. The side roads can be made functional if they are all connected so cars can drive on them. You can create parallel parking spaces, widen roads, create turning lanes or highway off and on ramps (which from my testing should be possible to make them functional if connected in a smart way), and any other creative use case you may come up with! All the decoration pieces are created on a rotation frame so even if you rotate your game it will all stay the way you placed it! In the future, if I have time, I plan to try and create car road decorations which could be placed on the parallel parking roads to look like there are cars parked there. :3
plugins.descriptionHtml:
A road additions set you can create better looking roads with! It comes with borderless and stackable roads as well as a sidewalk fence to be able to have a sidewalk only on one side of a borderless road.
The main part of the plugin are the decoration pieces that can be combined together to create your desired road look. Some of which have been added as roads to easily drag over larger areas, while decoration pieces can add the smaller details. The side roads can be made functional if they are all connected so cars can drive on them. You can create parallel parking spaces, widen roads, create turning lanes or highway off and on ramps (which from my testing should be possible to make them functional if connected in a smart way), and any other creative use case you may come up with!

All the decoration pieces are created on a rotation frame so even if you rotate your game it will all stay the way you placed it!

In the future, if I have time, I plan to try and create car road decorations which could be placed on the parallel parking roads to look like there are cars parked there. :3

plugins.name: Super Leche Restaurant
plugins.description: Hello, This is another building of the "Back From 85" Project, which will seek to bring back to life some buildings that disappeared due to the earthquake in Mexico on September 19, 1985. The Maria Ana Mier Escandón building It was an apartment building located in the Central Axis of Mexico City. Since 1949, it was home to the famous "Super Leche" restaurant. The building had commercial premises on the ground floor, and another four floors of apartments. In total, there were 80 apartments inside and 7 commercial premises, including the Super Leche Restaurant. The building collapsed on September 19, 1985, due to the earthquake that occurred that day. Currently, there is a metro station and a garden on the site. This plugin Includes: Maria Ana Mier Escandon Building: 7x7 Residential building, with influence 500 in culture and night Animations. Thank you for your support, Really.

Pedro (he had not yet been acclaimed and crowned emperor), on September 18, 1822. The colors of the flag were chosen by d. plugins.name: M/V Filipinas Ubay
plugins.description: One of the leading Cebu-based Shipping Line: Cokaliong Shipping Lines Inc (CSLI) will soon launch its 15th RORO-Passenger Vessel – M/V Filipinas Ubay. She is the latest addition to its growing fleet and is intended to be used in the Cebu-Ubay, Bohol and v.v. route. The vessel will have her maiden voyage this coming Friday, March 10 2023 and a launching ceremony in Ubay Port in Bohol will happen this Saturday, March 11 2023. The vessel started its life in Japan as the former Seto (later renamed as Seto II) of the Shikoku Kisen Co Ltd. which was launched in September 2003 and built by Fujiwara Shipbuilding in their Imabari yard. She has an overall length of 65 meters, a breadth of 15 meters and a Gross Registered Tonnage of 635 tons. She carries the IMO Number 8986470 and MMSI number 431501766. The ship has a steel hull with bow and stern ramps as access to her single car deck. Hence she is classified as a RORO (Roll-on Roll-off) Vessel. The vessel arrived in Cebu last November 15 2022. Few days after she was cleared from the required government regulatory permits, she then proceeded to Dynacast Shipyard in Danao, Cebu for her hull inspection and drydocking works. After the completion of the said works, she then stayed in the Cebu Pier 1 area for refitting and repainting works. The M/V Filipinas Ubay features a new livery where the existing Cokaliong yellow/gold paint has a small red and blue stripes at the side of the vessel. Do you like it? This is one of the newest modular ship plugin I built! And clearly, this is my first plugin of this style! Thank you tochiito for helping me making the night animation of the ship! This is the Newest Modular Ship Plugin in 2023. Rate /\ if you like it! Stay safe, everyone!

plugins.name: Hotel Del Prado
plugins.description: This is the second building of the "Back From 85" Project, which will seek to bring back to life some buildings that disappeared due to the earthquake in Mexico on September 19, 1985. Thank you for your Support! The Hotel del Prado is one of the 49 most remembered demolished properties in Mexico City. It was an imposing building, located on the central Avenida Juárez, Colonia Centro - Zona Poniente, between the streets of Revillagigedo and Azueta, it had a privileged view of the Alameda Central, which attracted the immediate attention of visitors. In 1985 it collapsed due to the fateful earthquake that Mexico City experienced. The only thing that could be rescued was the Diego Rivera mural that was in the lobby, which allowed the birth of the Diego Rivera Mural Museum. Includes Night animation, more updates to come. Special thanks to Daniel Gallardo!

plugins.description: The name ‘Wedding Tower’ refers to the wedding between the Grand Duke Ernst Ludwig and Princess Eleonore zu Solms-Hohensolms-Lich in the year 1905. After the announcement of the engagement, the Grand Duke consulted the Viennese architect Josef Maria Olbrich. Both of them were intrigued by the idea of creating a widely visible monument in commemoration of this event. The 48.5-meter-high tower designed by Olbrich was erected in the years 1907 to 1908 by Darmstadt’s urban building department. Type: Landmark Size: 4x4

plugins.name: Aviation & Space Museum
plugins.description: During the China National Day in 2022, players from China held a competition with the theme of traffic architecture. The competition is divided into two rounds, with a total of more than 20 players participating. Among them, the top ten players advanced to the second round, and they were asked to restore six Chinese airports in the game. The winners are Huashengyou, Menglilianyi, F-WWOW, Kongge, XixiHi and Xuerandeqizhi. This plugin is one of the prizes of this competition, and it has been given to the above 6 winners. Today, it will be available to all Theotown players. The Canadian Aviation and Space Museum is located in Ottawa. The Museum focuses on aviation in Canada, but within an international context, from its beginnings in 1909 to the present day. As Canada’s contribution to aviation expanded to include aerospace technology, the Museum’s collection and mandate grew to include space flight. The Collection itself consists of more than 130 aircraft and artifacts from both civil and military service. The most extensive aviation collection in Canada. size: 6*6

plugins.name: Maori pack
plugins.description: Maori are the indigenous Polynesian people of mainland New Zealand. Māori originated with settlers from East Polynesia, who arrived in New Zealand in several waves of canoe voyages between roughly 1320 and 1350. Over several centuries in isolation, these settlers developed their own distinctive culture, whose language, mythology, crafts, and performing arts evolved independently from those of other eastern Polynesian cultures. In this plugin package contains : A maori house, A maori gate, A maori statue, A maori canoe, and Two waka sailboat I suggest you use additional plugins for even better feel I hope you like it :)

plugins.name: Heightmap Export Tool
plugins.description: Please read the description before installing this plugin! This is a small tool (actually, a sidebar button) that allows you to create a heightmap of your city, including the buildings. This allows you to extract a heightmap from in-game worldgen, or to view your city as simple 3D model in blender/any heightmap view website. Notes: With highest resolution, which displays all the tiles on the map, the plugin will lag (but it's still usable). There is a possibility of UI being distorted on low resolutions, please report in comments if this happened to you. This doesn't create an ultra realistic detailed 3D model of every building in your city. Since image saving/editing in lua with theotown is either impossible or very complicated, to get a picture of your heightmap, screenshot&crop the output

plugins.description: Hi. Bevise's here. Everyone knows about it. An extremely famous cultural landmark. It is an ideal tourist destination not to be missed when coming to Italy. COLOSSEUM or COLOSSEO in Italian. It is the largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, and is still the largest standing amphitheatre in the world today, despite its age. plugins.description: Credit to Pounkiller for the cargo that I reskinned, Lobby for the code for the hangar and the vehicles I reskinned This airbase has been in the works for about a month now, and is still not representative of the final product meaning I'll add more content later. Some of the administrative buildings might also get a remake of. The runway could get some more functionality so that it (hopefully) lets planes take off, no promises though.

plugins.descriptionHtml:
Version: 1.0.0
Train management is a plugin to create and manage the train system in your cities.

* Define the train routes.

* No manual provided.

plugins.name: Four Seasons Place KL (update)
plugins.description: The Four Seasons Place is a 343 metre tall skyscraper located in Kuala Lumpur. It is the 4th tallest hotel-specific building in the world. It was distinct for housing the only Robinsons retailer in Malaysia, which later closed in 2020. With 73 storeys, the skyscraper is the second most prominent landmark in the Kuala Lumpur City Centre (KLCC), second to the Petronas Towers. The plugin was originally created on 3 June 2019. It was released initially on the forums. It was then uploaded to the Plugins store on 7 December later that year. I recently re-cladded the entire plugin (23rd-25th July 2022), after 3 years since I originally created it. I also added night lights to accompany the newer features released subsequently after the plugin's creation. The original versions of the plugin will still be available for downloading on the Forums (Link: https://forum.theotown.com/viewtopic.php?f=61&t=9877&p=149557&hilit=four+seasons+kuala+lumpur#p149557) Have fun downloading! Specifications: - Size: 8x8; - Base cost: 65kT; - Consumes 155 units of electricity, 165 units of water; - Height: 343 metres (1,125 feet) Additional graphics used from: - Trees by Kingtut - Cars and redwood trees by mdk_813 Update log: - v.1.0.1 (3 June 2019): Created plugin, posted on forums. - v.1.1.1 (July 2019): Second version introduced on forums. - v.1.2.1 (7 December 2019): Plugin uploaded to Plugins store. - v.2.0.1 (25 July 2022): Plugin recladded, night lights added.

plugins.name: Heart of Gelathus
plugins.description: Miners found a large beating object made from a gelatinous substance inside a cave near your city. Archaeologists say that this is the heart of Gelathus, an ancient gelatitan who is worshipped by the gulamen and gulawomen people of the old Gulaman Empire. According to legend, Gelathus has a wife named Gelathia, also a gelatitan. One day, Gelathia got sick and passed away quickly. The heart was transferred to a newly built building because the cave was unstable. Only a few selected researchers were allowed to interact with the heart and experiment in the underground laboratory. The building is filled with strict security and the heart is covered with multiple layers of transparent heavy duty glass. After a few tests, researchers found a way to convert the heart's energy into electricity. plugins.name: 33 Thomas Street
plugins.description: 33 Thomas Street is a 170 meter (or 550 foot) tall and mysterious skyscraper in New York City located at, well you guessed it, 33 Thomas Street. This isn't just any regular skyscraper though as it has no windows at all. But why would anyone design a skycraper with no windows? For one its highly impractical and it just looks really ugly. It looks like a headquarters for a supervillan or a evil 1984/Brave New World style dictator. So why was this building designed the way it is? The buildings was designed to be a main connection point for phone lines. The last thing anyone wanted was for the phone lines to stop working so nobody could call 911 during desperate times. So thats where the design of 33 Thomas Street comes from. The tower was designed to be able to withstand any number of disasters and emergencies including even a nuclear explosion. Thats why it has no windows and is made of very thick walls and floors of massive concrete. And you see those big dark holes on the sides of the tower? Those are basically giant air conditioning vents. It could get very hot inside without them, because well, no windows. At this current time it is still used as a phone line hub and is owned by the phone company AT&T. But is that all there is to it? I mean a building that looks like that must have some dark secret right? Well as it turns out it does. For a long time there was a rumour that the NSA would have a secret mass surveillance hub somewhere on the east coast, called codename TITANPOINTE. And through leaked classified documents leaked by famous whistleblower Edward Snowden it was essentially confirmed that TITANPOINTE is inside 33 Thomas Street so now about the plugin itself: The tower sits on a 6x6 tile and its a level TTT commercial building And to somewhat simulate the NSA moving in it also has a police influence. Oh and please don't ask for night animations for this one because like I said it has no windows. It just doesn't light up at night, even in real life.

He has some really cool plugins. And if you like old American buildings like me, consider looking at ADutchGuy's plugins too, he's my inspiration for making my plugin. plugins.name: Suburban Living
plugins.description: Welcome to Suburban Living v1.2 The main highlight of this plugin is a new zone - the suburban zone. It's cheaper and less demanding than the default residential zone, and only small, custom suburban buildings will be built here. It's perfect for the early game because it doesn't need large investments to place, and lower upkeep costs help with further development. However, you will need to replace those if you want to have dense and rich buildings in your city. Houses built on this zone will contain a bit less people than the default zones. They are completely random - up to a total of 1188 color and model combinations. If you provide them with parks, they will grow into bigger residences with higher population capacity. If they have education too, they can reach level 2. Suburban Living contains a few other features too - two new roads with winter frames, a 2x2 rotation aware park for small towns and a few decoration buildings placed automatically in the zone. Make sure to check the color bias setting too! This plugin is still in development - expect updates, fixes and new content, but most importantly, have fun!
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Suburban Living v1.2

The main highlight of this plugin is a new zone - the suburban zone. It's cheaper and less demanding than the default residential zone, and only small, custom suburban buildings will be built here. It's perfect for the early game because it doesn't need large investments to place, and lower upkeep costs help with further development. However, you will need to replace those if you want to have dense and rich buildings in your city.

Houses built on this zone will contain a bit less people than the default zones. They are completely random - up to a total of 1188 color and model combinations. If you provide them with parks, they will grow into bigger residences with higher population capacity. If they have education too, they can reach level 2.

Suburban Living contains a few other features too - two new roads with winter frames, a 2x2 rotation aware park for small towns and a few decoration buildings placed automatically in the zone. Make sure to check the color bias setting too!

plugins.name: Monolith
plugins.description: Monolith. Do you dare touch it? Please be sure to let grids finish this month of May 2022! Contains Monolith, some tools, some roads with unique ids in the transport/roads category and it's own category which contains Monolith and some monolithic tools used by Monolith. Do not build and touch Monolith in an established map until you know what it does! Update attempts to ensure conections between intersections. You can eyedrop these roads built by the monolith. Update 6/17/2021 restores main functionality. :) Update 5/1/2022 Just warning of upcoming change in grid placements next update. What it does: If you build Monolith (park): gives you 5000 monthly income. (To offset losses from road monthly costs) If you press Monolith: builds grid 18 patcher over a 100×100 area (whole map on small maps) (removes trees, rci buildings) (preserves zones in 7×7 patches) (clears trees in a 100×100 area). If you build 36 grid 18 patcher (decoration): Immediately builds grid 18 patcher over a 36×36 area. (clears trees in a 36×36 area). grid 18 patcher (decoration) if built where x and y are multiples of 18: starts building a grid of roads (18), pipes (9), and underground wires (9) over the entire reachable map from that point. If neither x or y is a multiple of 9 or 18 or the zone is airport or military, -->> removes itself leaving zones intact. grid 18 patcher fixes intersections at multiples of 18. grid 9 patcher (decoration) and grid 15 patcher (decoration) do guess what? They are sub-optimal. grid 15 patcher will place trees. 18 works by building along the grid lines. (Preserves existing trees). 9 and 15 work by building by building rectangles. (Existing trees removed or replaced).
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Monolith. Do you dare touch it?
Please be sure to let grids finish this month of May 2022!

Contains Monolith, some tools, some roads with unique ids in the transport/roads category and it's own category which contains Monolith and some monolithic tools used by Monolith.

Do not build and touch Monolith in an established map until you know what it does!

Update attempts to ensure conections between intersections. You can eyedrop these roads built by the monolith.
Update 6/17/2021 restores main functionality. :)
Update 5/1/2022 Just warning of upcoming change in grid placements next update.


What it does:
If you build Monolith (park): gives you 5000 monthly income. (To offset losses from road monthly costs)
If you press Monolith: builds grid 18 patcher over a 100×100 area (whole map on small maps) (removes trees, rci buildings) (preserves zones in 7×7 patches) (clears trees in a 100×100 area).
If you build 36 grid 18 patcher (decoration): Immediately builds grid 18 patcher over a 36×36 area. (clears trees in a 36×36 area).
grid 18 patcher (decoration) if built where x and y are multiples of 18: starts building a grid of roads (18), pipes (9), and underground wires (9) over the entire reachable map from that point. If neither x or y is a multiple of 9 or 18 or the zone is airport or military, -->> removes itself leaving zones intact.

grid 18 patcher fixes intersections at multiples of 18.

grid 9 patcher (decoration) and grid 15 patcher (decoration) do guess what? They are sub-optimal. grid 15 patcher will place trees.

18 works by building along the grid lines. (Preserves existing trees).

9 and 15 work by building by building rectangles. (Existing trees removed or replaced).

plugins.description: Hey Everyone.. Introducing a very famous landmark of Morocco "The Mausoleum of Mohammed V and Hassan Tower" The Mausoleum of Mohammed V (Arabic: ضريح محمد الخامس) is a mausoleum located across from the Hassan Tower in Rabat, Morocco. It contains the tombs of the Moroccan king Mohammed V and his two sons, late King Hassan II and Prince Abdallah. Hassan Tower is the minaret of an unfinished mosque in Rabat, Morocco.It is located in front of Mausoleum of Mohammed V. If the mosque was completed, it would be the largest mosque in the world. Now it is a famous tourist point in Rabat, Morocco Special thanks to DawoodMurtaza for texturing and night animation. This is the result of efforts of DawoodMurtaza. This pack contains, > Mausoleum of Mohammed V > Hassan Tower > Hassan Mosque (main hall) > Hassan Mosque Monument > Incomplete Pillars of Hassan Mosque > Light lamps I hope you will like it.. Ramadan Mubarak to all Muslims :)
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Hey Everyone..
Introducing a very famous landmark of Morocco
"The Mausoleum of Mohammed V and Hassan Tower"
The Mausoleum of Mohammed V (Arabic: ضريح محمد الخامس) is a mausoleum located across from the Hassan Tower in Rabat, Morocco. It contains the tombs of the Moroccan king Mohammed V and his two sons, late King Hassan II and Prince Abdallah.
Hassan Tower is the minaret of an unfinished mosque in Rabat, Morocco.It is located in front of Mausoleum of Mohammed V. If the mosque was completed, it would be the largest mosque in the world. Now it is a famous tourist point in Rabat, Morocco
Special thanks to DawoodMurtaza for texturing and night animation. This is the result of efforts of DawoodMurtaza.

> Mausoleum of Mohammed V

I hope you will like it..
Ramadan Mubarak to all Muslims :)

plugins.name: Airport Brandenburg
plugins.description: Good afternoon, everyone. Vönark is here again with a new plugin. This time things are more serious, I decided to create an exact copy of the whole airport. It took a lot of time, I hope for your support and appreciation of my work. Let's go through the plugin itself. This is an exact replica of Brandenburg Airport in Berlin, Germany. This pack contains more than 100 different parts. decorations, parking lots, stations, terminals, coverings and even airplanes - all this is in my pack, to make it as easy as possible for you, to build an airport. Since the project is really big, it may be difficult to build. In such a case, I'm going to make a construction manual. This is the second version of the text. Many thanks for the high ratings and positive comments. The work gave me a lot of pleasure.

plugins.description: Here are the flags of the subjects of the Russian Federation (so far 20 - the Republic of Altai, the Republic of Buryatia, the Republic of Dagestan, the Republic of Komi, the Republic of Kabardino-Balkaria, Sverdlovsk Region, North Ossetia Alania, the Republic of Tatarstan, the Republic of Tyva, Kamchatka Krai, Kurgan Region, the Republic of Mordovia, Primorsky Krai, Rostov Region, the Chechen Republic, the Republic of Chuvashia, Khabarovsk Krai, the Republic of Udmurtia, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug. Some textures have been fixed in this update. In addition, all (except 5, which will be added in the next update) flags of the countries of North, Central, South America and the West Indies have been added. Countries- not only states, but also dependent territories, various overseas Departments, etc. In addition, I made flags of the Austrian lands especially for one person. Brief information has been added for all country flags (official name, capital, language, area and population) In the next update I will try to add flags of African and European countries. Update 2 (and 3) added the remaining flags of America. Added flags of all African countries(with the exception of Somaliland and Melilla) and animation of the flag of Austria. Added all flags of European countries and 2 animations (at the request of workers) in the next update-Asia

plugins.name: Rhodes State Office Tower
plugins.description: Hello, I'm back again for my SECOND official released plugin! I'm very excited as I believe I've done a lot more in terms of detailing and the plugin overall compared to my previous Heyburn Building plugin. The Rhodes State Office Tower is a 41 story 629ft (192m) building in Columbus, Ohio. The tower itself is named for Ohio Governor James A. Rhodes who served as the 61st and 63rd Governor of the State of Ohio. The building itself has 1.2 million square feet of office space and employs nearly 4,000 state employees. The building was originally home to the Ohio State Supreme Court and the Ohio Statehouse sits in the shadows of the building which is directly adjacent across the street. The building cost $66 million US dollars and was originally supposed to be 150ft taller, however a last minute design change is the result of the odd shape. The building is the current tallest building in Columbus, surpassing the LeVeque Tower, and is the current 5th tallest building in the entire State of Ohio. I plan on adding night animations to the plugin eventually, and I'm looking into fixing the problem with the power and water generation thing, which was a complete accident in fhe script. Finally, I plan on releasing some more plugins eventually when I have adequate time, especially some more plugins from smaller to mid sized Midwestern American cities. Have fun with this plugin, cheers! -Brettig
