plugins.name: The Railroad Expansion v2.0
plugins.description: Introducing one of TheoTown biggest plugins ever made, and my biggest plugin ever by far. -Short Description- The Railroad expansion plugin is my largest plugin yet, and aim to add a large variety of trains, train station, rail tracks and other additions to spice up your gameplay and allows you to have a better experience. This plugin use a number of new functionalities, such as the ability to edit the length of trains, fully modulable train stations, new kind of rail-tracks and exclusive additions. This plugin is the result of months of works and was only possible thanks to the help of other plugin creators. Best of all ? It's available for 30 diamonds or an ad, basically an entire free dlc. -Version- The current version of the plugin is the version v2.0, and is the first major update since the release, it add 12 new trains, 2 new stations, retextured of many trains, as well as entirely retextured rail, bridges and tunnels texture. -Plans for the future- With the first large update released, I got absolutely no idea what to do next, and I'll likely stop the plugin there due to irl studies and stuff, and this, most likely until the next summer. Perhaps the future will see an update focused on other countries and maybe new types of trains, but for now, I will take a long and well deserved break. -Q&A- 1) Why is the plugin named Max's railroad expansion if you were helped in the developpment - Well young Timmy, ask no more, since content from other plugin creators was added, the name has been changed to "The Railroad Expansion", and all contributors to the plugin have been honored for their contribution. 2) Are you planning to add x train from x country ? - Planification for new assets is made in advance by the development team, therefore, we cant guarantee if your request will be added but any interesting requests has a change to be approved. In addition, due to my irl schedules, I no longer can find the time to work on this plugin, which is why the update scheduled for August only came this November. 3) How can i suggest a train ? - Any suggestion of train should include the model of the train engine, the nationality of the train and its purpose. For example, a regional train should include the name of the train, the model of the train-engine, the nationality of the train and the region it is used in. 4) Are maglev, steam trains, monorail & street cars planned ? - Some have just been added, but there will likely be not many more, since I need a break. 5) Will you add more rail-tracks instead of the current generic tracks ? - Yes, not right now tho, I want to eventually add more variety but it'll wait for when I got more time for myself. 6) Rotations seems odd with the large train station slopped roof... - I noticed that too, but i dont know how to fix that, therefore, it'll take some time because it's fixed, i advice to remove the slopped roof if you rotate the map and then to replace it once it's done. -Advices- 1)You are not allowed under any circumstances to (re)upload the plugin without my approval. 2)In order to use any textures from the plugin, you should request my approval first. 3)The plugin was developped on a pc and has been tested on a pc, therefore, the plugin can be a bit less efficient on lower end devices, especially if the game is in fast mode.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Introducing one of TheoTown biggest plugins ever made, and my biggest plugin ever by far.

-Short Description-
The Railroad expansion plugin is my largest plugin yet, and aim to add a large variety of trains, train station, rail tracks and other additions to spice up your gameplay and allows you to have a better experience. This plugin use a number of new functionalities, such as the ability to edit the length of trains, fully modulable train stations, new kind of rail-tracks and exclusive additions. This plugin is the result of months of works and was only possible thanks to the help of other plugin creators. Best of all ? It's available for 30 diamonds or an ad, basically an entire free dlc.

-Version-
The current version of the plugin is the version v2.0, and is the first major update since the release, it add 12 new trains, 2 new stations, retextured of many trains, as well as entirely retextured rail, bridges and tunnels texture.

-Plans for the future-
With the first large update released, I got absolutely no idea what to do next, and I'll likely stop the plugin there due to irl studies and stuff, and this, most likely until the next summer. Perhaps the future will see an update focused on other countries and maybe new types of trains, but for now, I will take a long and well deserved break.


-Q&A-
1) Why is the plugin named Max's railroad expansion if you were helped in the developpment
- Well young Timmy, ask no more, since content from other plugin creators was added, the name has been changed to "The Railroad Expansion", and all contributors to the plugin have been honored for their contribution.

2) Are you planning to add x train from x country ?
- Planification for new assets is made in advance by the development team, therefore, we cant guarantee if your request will be added but any interesting requests has a change to be approved. In addition, due to my irl schedules, I no longer can find the time to work on this plugin, which is why the update scheduled for August only came this November.

3) How can i suggest a train ?
- Any suggestion of train should include the model of the train engine, the nationality of the train and its purpose. For example, a regional train should include the name of the train, the model of the train-engine, the nationality of the train and the region it is used in.

4) Are maglev, steam trains, monorail & street cars planned ?
- Some have just been added, but there will likely be not many more, since I need a break.

5) Will you add more rail-tracks instead of the current generic tracks ?
- Yes, not right now tho, I want to eventually add more variety but it'll wait for when I got more time for myself.

6) Rotations seems odd with the large train station slopped roof...
- I noticed that too, but i dont know how to fix that, therefore, it'll take some time because it's fixed, i advice to remove the slopped roof if you rotate the map and then to replace it once it's done.

-Advices-
1)You are not allowed under any circumstances to (re)upload the plugin without my approval.
2)In order to use any textures from the plugin, you should request my approval first.
3)The plugin was developped on a pc and has been tested on a pc, therefore, the plugin can be a bit less efficient on lower end devices, especially if the game is in fast mode.

plugins.description: The Shinjuku Park Tower (新宿パークタワー, Shinjuku Pāku Tawā) is the second-tallest building in Shinjuku, Tokyo. It was designed by Kenzo Tange and completed in 1994. Shinjuku Park Tower is a single building consisting of three connected block-shaped elements; S tower, which is 235 m (771 ft) tall with 52 stories, C tower which is 209 m (686 ft) tall with 47 stories and N tower which is 182 m (597 ft) tall with 41 stories. Floors 1 to 8 are occupied by retail stores, floors 9 to 37 are office floors and floors 39 to 52 are occupied by the luxury Park Hyatt Tokyo hotel, which includes a swimming pool with panoramic views on the city. plugins.descriptionHtml:
Plugin Version : 2.03
Last Updated : 2021-8-27

Note :
- The button might be able to move on its own when movable function is activated on the phone that have a notch. You can disable the function and manually set the position.
- The button can be moved with hold the button then drag into another position.

(4) Previewing Buildings with Animation

plugins.name: Rio de Janeiro Pack
plugins.description: Atualização 01: 3 novos prédios adicionados! Atualização 02: 2 novos prédios adicionados e mudança de nome do plugin de Copacabana Mega Pack 2 para Rio de Janeiro Pack. Atualização 03: 2 novos prédios adicionados e problemas nos códigos solucionados (gasto de energia e água) PT BR: O Rio de Janeiro é uma das mais conhecidas cidades do Brasil, contruída entre os morros e o oceano Atlântico a cidade é repleta de edifícios residenciais charmosos que datam principalmente das décadas de 50 a 80. Este plugin apresenta 15 representações de prédios localizados nos bairros cariocas de Copacabana, Leme, Barra da Tijuca, Ipanema e São Conrado. Alguns dos prédios deste plug-in possuem uma representação do calçadão de Copacabana na calçada. Na vida real, a calçada desses prédios pode não ser assim. O calçadão de Copacabana na vida real foi modernizado por Roberto Burle Marx em 1970. ATENÇÃO: TODOS OS PRÉDIOS DESSE PACK POSSUEM ANIMAÇÃO NOTURNA E ALGUNS APRESENTAM CALÇADA DE CONCRETO! Update 03: 2 new buildings added and code related issues fixed (energy and water waste) PT BR: Rio de Janeiro is one of the most known cities in Brazil, built between the hills and the Atlantic Ocean the city is full of charming residential buildings that date mainly from the 50s to the 80s. This plugin features 15 representations of buildings located in the neighborhoods of Copacabana, Leme, Barra da Tijuca, Ipanema and São Conrado. Some of the buildings in this plug-in have a representation of the Copacabana sidewalk on the sidewalk. In real life, the sidewalks of these buildings may not be like this. The Copacabana boardwalk in real life was modernized by Roberto Burle Marx in 1970. ATTENTION: ALL BUILDINGS IN THIS PACK HAVE NIGHT ANIMATION AND SOME HAVE CONCRETE SIDEWALK! Hope you like it. Credits to Theo and Lobby for the texture of grass, concrete sidewalk and the tree used in one of the buildings. plugins.name: Minesweeper
plugins.description: Hello! It's my first try in Lua, and I've tried to make a classic Minesweeper game. How it works: - after installation there would be minesweeper category which contains two buttons: start and info - after clicking start button you'll be transitioned to a special game city - to start a game, you should click smile icon and choose a difficulty (easy, medium, hard, expert, custom) - above the play field there would be two screens: mines left and time spent, and two buttons: flag mode and normal mode Other mechanics fully reassemble classic Minesweeper from win95/2000/xp. Credits to developers for code Hope you'll like this plugin! UPDATE! - you can see your flags after losing the game - minor bug fix
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Hello! It's my first try in Lua, and I've tried to make a classic Minesweeper game. How it works:
- after installation there would be minesweeper category which contains two buttons: start and info
- after clicking start button you'll be transitioned to a special game city
- to start a game, you should click smile icon and choose a difficulty (easy, medium, hard, expert, custom)
- above the play field there would be two screens: mines left and time spent, and two buttons: flag mode and normal mode

Other mechanics fully reassemble classic Minesweeper from win95/2000/xp. Credits to developers for code

Hope you'll like this plugin!

UPDATE!
- you can see your flags after losing the game
- minor bug fix

plugins.name: King Power Mahanakhon (fixed)
plugins.description: This plugin introduces a new skyscraper to your city's skyline called King Power Mahanakhon. This mixed-use tower designed by German architect Ole Sheeran is the tallest building in Bangkok, Thailand and features an incredibly unique pixel design. In further detail, the "surrendering and taking of space" allows the creation of terraces and balconies, giving striking views of the city. It also captures the life of the city below and takes it all the way up the shaft of the building. The main goal of this plugin was to be as accurate to it's real-life counterpart as far as the pixel art median could allow: every window on this building was painstakingly mapped using numerous reference sources, leading to its late release. The first version of the plugin used compositions to make it rectangular, but I realized that was a bit of a mistake (just read the ratings on my plugin!) so I slapped it on a bog-standard 7x7 plate. I also added some cars, people, pools and other details onto the bottom as promised! I also fixed the floating glitch, thanks for pointing that out. Credit to hsda for the wonderful plugin idea and Lobby for the cars! Change log: 23/02/21 - Release 26/02/21 - Changed it from composition to baseplate and more details 27/02/21 - Fixed floating above water glitch
plugins.descriptionHtml:
This plugin introduces a new skyscraper to your city's skyline called King Power Mahanakhon. This mixed-use tower designed by German architect Ole Sheeran is the tallest building in Bangkok, Thailand and features an incredibly unique pixel design. In further detail, the "surrendering and taking of space" allows the creation of terraces and balconies, giving striking views of the city. It also captures the life of the city below and takes it all the way up the shaft of the building.

The main goal of this plugin was to be as accurate to it's real-life counterpart as far as the pixel art median could allow: every window on this building was painstakingly mapped using numerous reference sources, leading to its late release.

The first version of the plugin used compositions to make it rectangular, but I realized that was a bit of a mistake (just read the ratings on my plugin!) so I slapped it on a bog-standard 7x7 plate. I also added some cars, people, pools and other details onto the bottom as promised!

I also fixed the floating glitch, thanks for pointing that out.

Credit to hsda for the wonderful plugin idea and Lobby for the cars!

Change log:
23/02/21 - Release
26/02/21 - Changed it from composition to baseplate and more details
27/02/21 - Fixed floating above water glitch

plugins.descriptionHtml:
First of all I, would like to give credit to Mr. John Fred Delos Santos who helped me on the animation and codes of this plug in. He is the man behind the animation Changing Effect and many more.
Thank You Very Much Bro..
---
The Building

The clock tower of the Manila City Hall is an iconic trademark of Manila and of its city hall. The clock tower was unveiled in 1930. Being the largest clock tower in the Philippines, the hexagonal shaped tower has one red-faced clock placed on its three facets. In the evenings, the clock tower of the City Hall of Manila is kept illuminated by light.

---
The Plug in

The plug in is composed of 5 different color plus a changing animation effect to keep the building illuminated duting night transition.

It is cool when you put it as one of your landmarks although the building belongs in a public government category, you can use it to give glimpse on your night life.

---
Labels:

*Public - Management
*2x2
*5 Color and 1 animation effect.

Enjoy :')
-Deedzkie

plugins.name: Baybayin Letters Decoration
plugins.description: A small gift for the upcoming Baybayin support in TheoTown. CONTENT: * This plugin contains Baybayin Monument, and (non-rotational) Baybayin characters deco. * It has its own category under Public > Decorations > Baybayin * Each letter features Filipino word on their description. WHAT IS BAYBAYIN? The word Baybayin is a Tagalog term that refers to all the letters used in writing a language, that is to say, an “alphabet” – although, to be more precise, the baybayin is more like a syllabary. It is from the root baybáy meaning, “spell.” This name for the old Filipino script appeared in one of the earliest Philippine language dictionaries ever published, the Vocabulario de Lengua Tagala of 1613. Early Spanish accounts usually called the baybayin “Tagalog letters” or “Tagalog writing.” And the Visayans called it “Moro writing” because it was imported from Manila, which was one of the ports where many products from Muslim traders entered what are now known as the Philippine islands. The Bikolanos called the script basahan and the letters, guhit. The information revolution has allowed Filipinos to learn more about the precolonial era on the Internet than was ever taught in Philippine schools. As a result many Filipinos are taking a new interest in their own heritage and it is usually the baybayin that catches their attention first. Through the use of computer fonts, the baybayin is now being used in graphic designs for web sites, multimedia art, jewellery, T-shirts, and logos. And for some Pinoys, it seems that the path has come full circle. Whereas long ago the Visayan pintados were tattooed according to their status in the community, today a growing number of young Filipinos are getting tattooed with baybayin characters to show their pride in their heritage. ᜀᜃᜓ ᜀᜅ᜔ ᜁᜌᜓᜅ᜔ ᜑᜇᜌ

plugins.name: Seobina University (modular)
plugins.description: The motif of Keimyung University (Daegu, Republic of Korea). It's the building module that we're building. It's an early 20th century style red brick building pack. This plug-in consists of the following buildings: 1) 1x12C : Triangular roof, 2nd floor, commercial Level 1 (Transition from left to right) 2) 1x13C : Triangular roof, 3nd floor, commercial Level 1 (Transition from left to right) 3) 1x1D: Green roof, 2nd floor, commercial level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 3rd floor building) 4) 1x1E : Gray roof, 2nd floor, Commercial Level 1(Upgrade: Extended to 3rd floor building) 5) 1x1N: porch, 2nd floor, commercial level 1 6) 1x13S: Corner, 3nd floor, commercial Level 1 7) 2x23C : Triangular roof, 3rd floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right) 8) 2x25C : Triangular roof, 5rd floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right) 9) 2x2D: Green roof, 3rd floor, commercial level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 5th floor building) 10) 2x2E : Gray roof, 3rd floor, Commercial Level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 5th floor building) 11) 2x25G : a whole glass building, 5th floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right) 12) 2x27G : a whole glass building, 7th floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right) 13) 3x33C: Elementary and secondary education, triangular roof, 3th floor building (shifting from left to right) 14) 3x35C: Elementary and secondary education, triangular roof, 5th floor building (shifting from left to right) 15) 3x3D: Commercial Level 1, 5th floor building 16) 3x3E: Commercial level 1, 8th floor building 17) 3x35G : a whole glass building, 5th floor, Management (City Hall) (Transition from left to right) 18) 3x38G : a whole glass building, 8th floor, Management (City Hall) (Transition from left to right) Building 13, 14, we've got a lot of educational capabilities. Building 17, 18, we've got a lot of Management capabilities. The rest of the buildings also had a commercial level 1, which made it possible to implement a red brick city in the early 20th century. Every building from 1~18 is free to connect with each other. Other commercial and industrial decorations are available. Night view is supported for all buildings.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
The motif of Keimyung University (Daegu, Republic of Korea).
It's the building module that we're building.
It's an early 20th century style red brick building pack.

This plug-in consists of the following buildings:
1) 1x12C : Triangular roof, 2nd floor, commercial Level 1 (Transition from left to right)
2) 1x13C : Triangular roof, 3nd floor, commercial Level 1 (Transition from left to right)
3) 1x1D: Green roof, 2nd floor, commercial level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 3rd floor building)
4) 1x1E : Gray roof, 2nd floor, Commercial Level 1(Upgrade: Extended to 3rd floor building)
5) 1x1N: porch, 2nd floor, commercial level 1
6) 1x13S: Corner, 3nd floor, commercial Level 1
7) 2x23C : Triangular roof, 3rd floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right)
8) 2x25C : Triangular roof, 5rd floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right)
9) 2x2D: Green roof, 3rd floor, commercial level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 5th floor building)
10) 2x2E : Gray roof, 3rd floor, Commercial Level 1 (Upgrade: Extended to 5th floor building)
11) 2x25G : a whole glass building, 5th floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right)
12) 2x27G : a whole glass building, 7th floor, commercial level 1 (Transition from left to right)
13) 3x33C: Elementary and secondary education, triangular roof, 3th floor building (shifting from left to right)
14) 3x35C: Elementary and secondary education, triangular roof, 5th floor building (shifting from left to right)
15) 3x3D: Commercial Level 1, 5th floor building
16) 3x3E: Commercial level 1, 8th floor building

Building 13, 14, we've got a lot of educational capabilities.
Building 17, 18, we've got a lot of Management capabilities.
The rest of the buildings also had a commercial level 1, which made it possible to implement a red brick city in the early 20th century.

plugins.description: 保定火车站位于中国河北省保定市，建立于1899年，曾经是中国十大火车站之一。经过多次扩建改造，保定站总建筑面积为4.2万平方米，站场规模为5台10线，车站设计最高聚集人数为6000人，具备年发送千万旅客能力。本插件为您带来了保定火车站的站房部分。 —————————————————— Baoding Railway Station is located in Baoding City, Hebei Province, China. Founded in 1899, it was once one of the top ten railway stations in China. After many times of expansion and transformation, Baoding Station has a total construction area of 42,000 square meters, with 5 stations and 10 lines. The maximum number of people gathered at the station is 6,000, capable of sending tens of millions of passengers annually. This plugin brings you the station room of Baoding Railway Station.

plugins.name: M.L.I.C Building, NYK (1909).
plugins.description: The Metropolitan Life Insurance Company Building (a very long name) is the headquarters for the Metropolitan Life Insurance Company. It was built at New York, in 1909. At the height of 213.4 metres and with 50 stories, this building is the tallest building in the world from 1909 to 1913, surpassing the Singer Building. Its main features is a clock face appearing 4 sides on the wall of the building, a prominent landmark in NYK during that period. In fact, it remains one of the tallest clock towers to have ever existed. Currently, it is now a hotel, and also a US Registered National Landmark, preserved for later generations to admire. The present building is based on the modern state, following a reconstruction of the smaller structure next to the skyscraper in Art-Deco styles during the 1930s. Its main features is a clock face appearing 4 sides on the wall of the building, a prominent landmark in NYK during that period. In fact, it remains one of the tallest clock towers to have ever existed. Currently, it is now a hotel, and also a US Registered National Landmark, preserved for later generations to admire.

plugins.name: Refreshed Roads (v1.1)
plugins.description: ***** What's New in v1.1 ***** + Added the multiple bridge types which were missing from v1.0. ===== Description ===== Personally, I made this plugin because I thought the road graphics were off. Example: On a two way expressway, the median is dotted. But on a four lane highway (one side has two lanes), we instead have a straight, undisturbed line splitting the lanes in half? Even if I wasn't American, I'd still think these graphics wouldn't make any sense. So instead, I just remade the road graphics by overriding the vanilla roads and putting a more logical texture on them. The roads from Neighborhood Roads can also be found here, with textures that go along with these. Also, texture, resource, or graphics plugins should be a thing because there are some things that don't even use these textures, such as premade intersections...Not to mention, if any region disallows plugins, these roads can NOT be used, and you will have to disable them. ===== Additions (from Neighborhood Roads) ===== + Suburban Roads + Truck Prohibited Roads + Truck Prohibited One Way Roads ===== Changes ===== Re-textured most vanilla roads except for the dirt road. ========== Enjoy!
plugins.descriptionHtml:
***** What's New in v1.1 *****
+ Added the multiple bridge types which were missing from v1.0.

===== Description =====
Personally, I made this plugin because I thought the road graphics were off.

Example: On a two way expressway, the median is dotted. But on a four lane highway (one side has two lanes), we instead have a straight, undisturbed line splitting the lanes in half? Even if I wasn't American, I'd still think these graphics wouldn't make any sense.

So instead, I just remade the road graphics by overriding the vanilla roads and putting a more logical texture on them. The roads from Neighborhood Roads can also be found here, with textures that go along with these.

Also, texture, resource, or graphics plugins should be a thing because there are some things that don't even use these textures, such as premade intersections...Not to mention, if any region disallows plugins, these roads can NOT be used, and you will have to disable them.

===== Additions (from Neighborhood Roads) =====
+ Suburban Roads
+ Truck Prohibited Roads
+ Truck Prohibited One Way Roads

===== Changes =====
Re-textured most vanilla roads except for the dirt road.

==========

Enjoy!

plugins.descriptionHtml:
===== Full Name =====
> Modulable Shopping Mall (v1.1)

===== Description ====
> Shopping malls, or shopping arcades, are terms usually referring to places serving as a large central hub of commercial and retail.
> In America, these shopping malls would typically have a walkway, with storefronts lined up and facing the path. These halls would typically end with entrances into the mall, or with larger stores, known as anchor stores, which serve as main attractions to the mall.
> There are other shopping mall plugins, which are actually excellent, but if you don't feel like they fulfilled your needs, or you felt like they were complicated, you have this plugin, which allows you to simply build American-like shopping malls in your very own TheoTown cities.
> Your shopping malls will have their own spheres of influence for parks and culture. The radius of influence will depend on the type of mall and the amount of floors.

===== Unlock Requirements =====
> Generic (One Floor) Parts | Level 7
> Generic (Two Floor) Parts | Level 8
> Skylit Parts | Level 11

===== Important Notes =====
> All buildings will be called Commercial TT, despite the fact that I provided a title and description of the buildings. The game itself does that and I haven't found any way around this. However, when placing the buildings, the name is found in the top right corner.
> Unfortunately, in America, they seem to dying out in this Retail Apocalypse, which has been plaguing the retailing industry for the last decade, but that doesn't have to be replicated here in TheoTown.

===== What's New in v1.1 =====
> Added anchors. Like I said, these are found at the end of halls. For now, they do not have any night animation.
> Category icons are no longer the same.
> Small ID change to the Generic Hall (One Floor). You will have to replace them after this update.
> Price lowered from 55 to 50.

==========

Enjoy your shopping malls!

plugins.name: José Rizal Monument
plugins.description: The Rizal Monument (original title: Motto Stella, Latin, "guiding star") is a memorial in Rizal Park in Manila, Philippines built to commemorate the executed Filipino nationalist, José Rizal. The monument consists of a standing bronze sculpture of Rizal, with an obelisk, set on a stone base within which his remains are interred. A plaque on the pedestal's front reads: "To the memory of José Rizal, patriot and martyr, executed on Bagumbayan Field December Thirtieth 1896. This monument is dedicated by the people of the Philippine Islands." This plugin is a 5x5 park categorized with night animations, flag animations and changing guards animations.

plugins.name: Fort Drum/ El Frailé
plugins.description: It was unique among forts built by the United States between the Civil War and early World War II, both as a sea fort and in having turrets. It was captured and occupied by the Japanese during World War II, and was recaptured by the U.S. after U.S. forces ignited petroleum and gasoline in the fort, leaving it permanently out of commission. Sixty-eight Japanese soldiers perished in the blaze. It took the U.S. soldiers days before they could even go into the fortress because of the heat. The ruins of the fort is located in Manila Bay between the Corregidor Island and Cavite.

plugins.name: The Heyburn Building
plugins.description: The Heyburn Building is a 250 foot (76 meter) tall building in Lousiville, Kentucky. The building was completed in 1928, and was built on the site of the Avery Mansion, home to suffragist Susan Look Avery. The building was built on the "magic corner", at 4th and Broad Street, and helped turn what was once a posh residential area, into a commercialized district that rivalled Louisville's Main Street. It was the tallest building in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, until a vertical addition was completed on the Commonwealth Building in 1955, also in Louisville. This is my first public plugin, so please have fun. Also, I am planning on creating an older American small to mid sized skyscrapers pack that should be released in a little while (this building will be in the pack). So long and enjoy!

plugins.description: -Short Description- Pinus Pinaster, known as the Maritime Pine Tree is a coniferous tree of the genus Pinus, most commonly found in southwestern France or along the mediterranean coast, from Portugal to Greece and Tunisia. The plugin can spawn several variants of the tree, the supertall variant, the tall variant, the medium variant, the small variant and the dead variant. It also include a preview frame similar to the one of the western hemlock tree. -Short Q&A- 1)How much variants of the tree are added with this plugin ? > At this time, the plugin add a total of 18 trees, including 4 supertall variants, 3 tall variants, 5 medium variants, 3 small variants and 3 dead variants. 2)Will you add more variants ? > Probably not, altough i can always change my mind if i find the existing amount of tree to not be enough. 3)Why didn't you update the old plugin instead of making us use diamonds > The old maritime pine tree plugin did not fit my quality standard and was too badly done with many texture flaws, i decided a month ago to remake a new plugin with better quality tree and a month after, i am finally done with a plugin much better than the previous one. As i spent a lot of time on that plugin, i thought that my work deserved some kind of reward which is why you can buy the plugin for simply 30 diamonds or by watching an Ad. -Advices- 1)You are not allowed under any circumstances to (re)upload the plugin without my approval. 2)In order to use any textures from the tree, you should request my approval first.

It also include a preview frame similar to the one of the western hemlock tree.

1)How much variants of the tree are added with this plugin ?
> At this time, the plugin add a total of 18 trees, including 4 supertall variants, 3 tall variants, 5 medium variants, 3 small variants and 3 dead variants.

2)Will you add more variants ?

> The old maritime pine tree plugin did not fit my quality standard and was too badly done with many texture flaws, i decided a month ago to remake a new plugin with better quality tree and a month after, i am finally done with a plugin much better than the previous one. Its AdmiralCarl here's my newest plugin The Hassan II Mosque, Its a 6x6 rmosque with soundclick and night animation and wide influences. The Hassan II Mosque (Arabic: مسجد الحسن الثاني‎, French: Grande Mosquée Hassan II) is a mosque in Casablanca, Morocco. It is the largest functioning mosque in Africa and is the 7th largest in the world.Its minaret is the world's second tallest minaret at 210 metres (689 ft). Completed in 1993, it was designed by Michel Pinseau under the guidance of King Hassan II and built by Moroccan artisans from all over the kingdom. The minaret is 60 stories high topped by a laser, the light from which is directed towards Mecca. The mosque stands on a promontory looking out to the Atlantic Ocean; worshippers can pray over the sea but there is no glass floor looking into the sea. The walls are of hand-crafted marble and the roof is retractable. A maximum of 105,000 worshippers can gather together for prayer: 25,000 inside the mosque hall and another 80,000 on the mosque's outside ground. Shoutout to Youssef Ben Chekhe for suggesting this beautiful mosque and to my muslim friend Adel Macugar. Have a Blessed day. Thank you.

plugins.name: Old Church - Edit by Koala
plugins.description: This plugin adds an new (and at the same time - old!) 2x2 church to the game. This church was supposed to be in the game but then the creator of the game - theotheoderich made a new 3x3 church along with a 3x3 mosque to go along it. This church wasn't enabled in the game because that the two religions in the game have an equal amount of buildings. In this plugin, the church comes back to TheoTown. I made a few edits to bring it to todays standards: - church shadows added - fixed tree shadows (it used the old shadowing design) - fixed tile proportions (was 66 pixels wide, now 64 like other buildings in the game) - added winter graphics (winter mode did not exist when this church was drawn :) ) - now unlocked on rank 2 (small village) - price is 2500, monthly price is 12 - influence between 1x1 neighbourhood church and 3x3 small church All rights belong to theotheoderich as he is the maker. I only edited it and made it into a plugin. If you don't want to spend diamonds, you can download it for free from the offical TheoTown forum. Have fun!
plugins.descriptionHtml:
This plugin adds an new (and at the same time - old!) 2x2 church to the game.

This church was supposed to be in the game but then the creator of the game - theotheoderich made a new 3x3 church along with a 3x3 mosque to go along it. This church wasn't enabled in the game because that the two religions in the game have an equal amount of buildings.

In this plugin, the church comes back to TheoTown. I made a few edits to bring it to todays standards:
- church shadows added
- fixed tree shadows (it used the old shadowing design)
- fixed tile proportions (was 66 pixels wide, now 64 like other buildings in the game)
- added winter graphics (winter mode did not exist when this church was drawn :) )
- now unlocked on rank 2 (small village)
- price is 2500, monthly price is 12
- influence between 1x1 neighbourhood church and 3x3 small church

All rights belong to theotheoderich as he is the maker. I only edited it and made it into a plugin. If you don't want to spend diamonds, you can download it for free from the offical TheoTown forum.

Have fun!

plugins.description: -Short Description- Tsuga-Heterophylla, known as the western Hemlock Tree is a coniferous tree of the genus Tsuga, most commonly found in the north-west part of north-america, from Oregon to the south-east part of Alaska, it is also the state-tree of the Washington state. The plugin can spawn several variants of the tree, the supertall variant, the tall variant, the medium variant, the small variant and the dead variant. It is also my first tree plugin to feature a custom preview frame. -Short Q&A- 1)How much variants of the tree are added with this plugin ? > At this time, the plugin add a total of 24 trees, including 4 supertall variants, 6 tall variants, 6 medium variants, 4 small variants and 4 dead variants. 2)Will you add more variants ? > Probably not, altough i can always change my mind if i find the existing amount of tree to not be enough. -Advices- 1)You are not allowed under any circumstances to (re)upload the plugin without my approval. 2)In order to use any textures from the tree, you should request my approval first.

The plugin can spawn several variants of the tree, the supertall variant, the tall variant, the medium variant, the small variant and the dead variant. It is also my first tree plugin to feature a custom preview frame.


-Short Q&A-
1)How much variants of the tree are added with this plugin ?
> At this time, the plugin add a total of 24 trees, including 4 supertall variants, 6 tall variants, 6 medium variants, 4 small variants and 4 dead variants.

2)Will you add more variants ?
> Probably not, altough i can always change my mind if i find the existing amount of tree to not be enough.

2)In order to use any textures from the tree, you should request my approval first.

plugins.description: Hello, guys! Updates: •New Profile •Night Animation Since my plug-in was suspended for its lack of quality, I've decided to give it a brand-new look, replacing the old look that wasn't really appealing. So I'll introduce you... The New Rizal World Trade Center. Note: This building, and all the places mentioned, are fictional, and any resemblance to the real-life names and places is purely confidential. The skyscraper has a large influence radius in Culture, Management and Parks. It is suitable for large metropolises where it blends with other skyscrapers. The construction cost is still at 1,000,000 Theons and it has an upkeep of 2,000 Theons every time. It can be found in awards category. I want to give credits to the following: •My fellow plug-in creator, boblovespi for the glass texture(extracted from his Jin Mao Tower plug-in); and •Our beloved developers, Lobby and Theo, for the trees. And I also want to thank my fellow Filipino friend and also a plug-in maker, Zexus, for the tips on texturing, and agnesiann121 for the night animation codes. For any inquiries, suggestions and complaints, my feel free to message me through my Discord account, Facebook Account (Paulien James Lozada) or in this forum. I'm willing to take any suggestions and criticisms(not insults though, let's be careful), and hopefully I can give it more tweaks soon enough. I hope you enjoy this plug-in. 😁
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Hello, guys!

Updates:
•New Profile
•Night Animation

Since my plug-in was suspended for its lack of quality, I've decided to give it a brand-new look, replacing the old look that wasn't really appealing. So I'll introduce you...

The New Rizal World Trade Center.

Note: This building, and all the places mentioned, are fictional, and any resemblance to the real-life names and places is purely confidential.

The skyscraper has a large influence radius in Culture, Management and Parks. It is suitable for large metropolises where it blends with other skyscrapers. The construction cost is still at 1,000,000 Theons and it has an upkeep of 2,000 Theons every time. It can be found in awards category.

I want to give credits to the following:
•My fellow plug-in creator, boblovespi for the glass texture(extracted from his Jin Mao Tower plug-in); and
•Our beloved developers, Lobby and Theo, for the trees.

And I also want to thank my fellow Filipino friend and also a plug-in maker, Zexus, for the tips on texturing, and agnesiann121 for the night animation codes.

For any inquiries, suggestions and complaints, my feel free to message me through my Discord account, Facebook Account (Paulien James Lozada) or in this forum. I'm willing to take any suggestions and criticisms(not insults though, let's be careful), and hopefully I can give it more tweaks soon enough.

I hope you enjoy this plug-in. 😁

plugins.name: Part 1: NASA SCA Latest Model
plugins.description: The Shuttle Carrier Aircraft (SCA) are two extensively modified Boeing 747 airliners that NASA used to transport Space Shuttle orbiters. One is a 747-100 model, while the other is a short-range 747-100SR. The SCAs were used to ferry Space Shuttles from landing sites back to the Shuttle Landing Facility at the Kennedy Space Center. The orbiters were placed on top of the SCAs by Mate-Demate Devices, large gantry-like structures that hoisted the orbiters off the ground for post-flight servicing then mated them with the SCAs for ferry flights. In approach and landing test flights conducted in 1977, the test shuttle Enterprise was released from an SCA during flight and glided to a landing under its own control. Source/s: -https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shuttle_Carrier_Aircraft Editor's Note: There is more to come. 4 May 2020 -Minor fix

plugins.name: Com Fences and Props Pack
plugins.description: Assalamualaykum and Mabuhay! Are you tired looking at bare concrete under the highway just like how your life seems so empty and useless right now? Are you tired of seeing those empty streets with no humans in sight? Just like how you felt alone when all of those people you knew abandoned you? Do you feel so helpless when you see that you can't put diagonal fences on your highways and get forced placing an annoying square styled fence on it? Like how you felt like you don't belong to anywhere and being a burden to everybody? WELL SAY NO MORE I PRESENT TO YOU THIS NEW COMMERCIAL FENCES AND PROPS PACK! щ(゜ロ゜щ) I'd like to thank Theo and Lobby for the textures used in this pack. This features 5 commercial fences for your elevated highways, 3 diagonal fences to choose from, a garbage bin that can be plopped via fence style, a food walkway for your streets, and a 2x2 food park for your citizens to rest and eat! The diagonal fence is incomplete though, codings and textures will contradict with fences being plopped on diagonal roads facing south (In-game south). So this will suffice roads that are facing north only. I also advise experimenting with the fences so you'd get used to it. Thank you and I hope you'd enjoy this plugin!
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Assalamualaykum and Mabuhay!

Are you tired looking at bare concrete under the highway just like how your life seems so empty and useless right now? Are you tired of seeing those empty streets with no humans in sight? Just like how you felt alone when all of those people you knew abandoned you? Do you feel so helpless when you see that you can't put diagonal fences on your highways and get forced placing an annoying square styled fence on it? Like how you felt like you don't belong to anywhere and being a burden to everybody?

WELL SAY NO MORE I PRESENT TO YOU THIS NEW COMMERCIAL FENCES AND PROPS PACK! щ(゜ロ゜щ)

This features 5 commercial fences for your elevated highways, 3 diagonal fences to choose from, a garbage bin that can be plopped via fence style, a food walkway for your streets, and a 2x2 food park for your citizens to rest and eat!

The diagonal fence is incomplete though, codings and textures will contradict with fences being plopped on diagonal roads facing south (In-game south). So this will suffice roads that are facing north only. I also advise experimenting with the fences so you'd get used to it.

Thank you and I hope you'd enjoy this plugin!

plugins.name: Independence Flagpole
plugins.description: The Independence Flagpole or the Philippine National Flagpole is a 45.72 m (150.0 ft) flagpole located near the Rizal Monument in Rizal Park in Manila, Philippines. It is the highest flagpole in the country. The Independence Flagpole was the location where the Philippine flag was hoisted on July 4, 1946, when full independence was achieved from the United States. The flagpole was designed to be at 45.72 m (150.0 ft) high but was damaged by a typhoon in 1995 reducing the flagpole's height to just 32 m (105 ft). Source/s: -https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Independence_Flagpole Editor's Note: -If you are familiar with the flag it is from Red Alert 2. Since the flag was also big so I used it. For additional information, there is no Philippine flag in the game nor in the mods. -I did not expect how big the flag was. - S M O O T H 20 June 2020 -Resize of the flag -Some minor graphics fix

plugins.name: Hesco Bastion Wall
plugins.description: The Concertainer, known colloquially as the HESCO MIL, Hesco barrier, or Hesco bastion, is a modern gabion primarily used for flood control and military fortifications. It is made of a collapsible wire mesh container and heavy-duty fabric liner and used as a temporary to semi-permanent levee or blast wall against small-arms fire and/or explosives. It has seen considerable use in Iraq and Afghanistan. Originally designed for use on beaches and marshes for erosion and flood control, the HESCO barrier quickly became a popular security device in the 1990s. HESCO barriers continue to be used for their original purpose. The Concertainer was originally developed by Jimi Heselden, a British entrepreneur and ex-coal miner, who founded HESCO Bastion Ltd. in 1989 to manufacture his invention. The brand name for the barrier is a portmanteau of the words "concertina" and "container". Assembling the HESCO MIL units entails unfolding it and filling it with sand, soil or gravel, usually using a front end loader. The placement of the barrier is generally very similar to the placement of a sandbag barrier or earth berm except that room must generally be allowed for the equipment used to fill the barrier. The main advantage of HESCO barriers, strongly contributing to their popularity with troops and flood fighters, is the quick and easy setup. Previously, people had to fill sandbags, a slow undertaking, with one worker filling about 20 sandbags per hour. Workers using HESCO barriers and a front end loader can do ten times the work of those using sandbags. Source/s: -https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hesco_bastion Editor's Note: -This part of my Modern Military pack. -Is Timmy here?

plugins.name: Banderitas Col. 0
plugins.description: The Filipino word “banderitas” came from the Spanish “banderita” meaning small flag or small pennant. The Philippines was colonized by Spain during the reign of King Philip (where the country got its name from). Spain’s colonialization of the Philippines for about 300 years finally ended on June 12, 1898, the country’s independence day. Banderitas are usually small flag-shaped pieces of paper or plastic that are arranged in a string and hung up during fiestas. Source/s: -https://photoniompong.com/2015/05/12/the-banderitas/ Editor's Note: -Thumbnail by Thiago -More to come -Passenger cars only 2 June 2020 update: -Fixed the whole thing for not being passable underneath by cars

plugins.name: Part 2: NASA SCA First Model
plugins.description: This plane is carrying a space ship. Why do I have a 50-pound weight limit on my suitcase!? The Shuttle Carrier Aircraft (SCA) are two extensively modified Boeing 747 airliners that NASA used to transport Space Shuttle orbiters. One is a 747-100 model, while the other is a short-range 747-100SR. The SCAs were used to ferry Space Shuttles from landing sites back to the Shuttle Landing Facility at the Kennedy Space Center. The orbiters were placed on top of the SCAs by Mate-Demate Devices, large gantry-like structures that hoisted the orbiters off the ground for post-flight servicing then mated them with the SCAs for ferry flights. In approach and landing test flights conducted in 1977, the test shuttle Enterprise was released from an SCA during flight and glided to a landing under its own control. Source/s: -https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shuttle_Carrier_Aircraft Editor's Note: I might stop the NASA SCAs for a while to focus on other plugins. I'd be back on doing this again.

This plane is carrying a space ship. Why do I have a 50-pound weight limit on my suitcase!?

The Shuttle Carrier Aircraft (SCA) are two extensively modified Boeing 747 airliners that NASA used to transport Space Shuttle orbiters. One is a 747-100 model, while the other is a short-range 747-100SR.

The SCAs were used to ferry Space Shuttles from landing sites back to the Shuttle Landing Facility at the Kennedy Space Center. The orbiters were placed on top of the SCAs by Mate-Demate Devices, large gantry-like structures that hoisted the orbiters off the ground for post-flight servicing then mated them with the SCAs for ferry flights.

In approach and landing test flights conducted in 1977, the test shuttle Enterprise was released from an SCA during flight and glided to a landing under its own control.

plugins.name: A small part of the Ming Tombs
plugins.description: Hello!It is my new plugin-A small part of Ming Tombs The Ming Tombs are located in the foothills of Tianshou Mountain, Changping District, Beijing, with a total area of more than 120 square kilometers and about 50 kilometers from Tiananmen Square. The Ming Tombs are located in a small basin surrounded by mountains in the east, west and north. The hills are surrounded by mountains and the middle is a plain. There is a small river winding in front of the tomb. From the seventh year of Yongle (1409), he began to be the Changling tomb in May, until the last emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Chongzhen, was buried in the tomb. Over 230 years, 13 tombs of emperors, seven tombs of concubines, and one eunuch were built. A total of 13 emperors, 23 queens, 2 crown princes, more than 30 concubines, and 2 eunuchs were buried. As of 2011, Changling, Dingling, Zhaoling and Shenlu have been opened.

plugins.description: Hi there! Here I bring you another famous Argentinian building. The Abasto Market is located in the Almagro neighbourhood, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. plugins.name: Moon phase ind. + No Parks
plugins.description: https://youtu.be/_Iv2BAZmny4 Update includes new functionality for No5 park. It will turn off the other No parks. A level TTT industrial. Maybe they process moon rocks, all I know is there is an animation of the moon phase when placed or viewed in the menu. :) Up to 177 may be built and they are allowed to autobuild. To place manually, goto the zones menu, far to the right, choose industrial, choose III, and search for the moon phase. When building, it will be like placing trees, choose a start point, then the end point. The actual plugin is slightly different from the screenshot, the animation is lowered. Additions: Two roads that build all over the place (in addition to the chosen line) in no particular direction when placed. They will remove things to do so. Four (actually 8) No parks, two that can be placed (No 2 and No 5), one that can be upgraded to No 2. No means NO you don't want to use them. If you place a No 2, you have a few game days to surround it with roads completely on FLAT ground. Except for No 5, all Nos will remove everything except for non-removables and flat roads. They will not stop at water, and may take bridges and roads built over hilly terrain. Luckily, if contained or the map is small, they will disappear after two or three game years. Otherwise, you will have to figure out how to remove them. I recommend having billions of Theons for this quest! ● The purpose of the parks IS to remove things, so be careful! You can place the moonphase industrials. The area has to be zoned dense industrial! :)
plugins.descriptionHtml:
https://youtu.be/_Iv2BAZmny4

Update includes new functionality for No5 park. It will turn off the other No parks.

A level TTT industrial. Maybe they process moon rocks, all I know is there is an animation of the moon phase when placed or viewed in the menu. :)

Up to 177 may be built and they are allowed to autobuild.
To place manually, goto the zones menu, far to the right, choose industrial, choose III, and search for the moon phase.

When building, it will be like placing trees, choose a start point, then the end point.

The actual plugin is slightly different from the screenshot, the animation is lowered.

Additions:

Two roads that build all over the place (in addition to the chosen line) in no particular direction when placed. They will remove things to do so.

Four (actually 8) No parks, two that can be placed (No 2 and No 5), one that can be upgraded to No 2. No means NO you don't want to use them. If you place a No 2, you have a few game days to surround it with roads completely on FLAT ground. Except for No 5, all Nos will remove everything except for non-removables and flat roads. They will not stop at water, and may take bridges and roads built over hilly terrain.
Luckily, if contained or the map is small, they will disappear after two or three game years. Otherwise, you will have to figure out how to remove them. I recommend having billions of Theons for this quest!
●
The purpose of the parks IS to remove things, so be careful!

You can place the moonphase industrials. The area has to be zoned dense industrial! :)

plugins.name: Vinta
plugins.description: Kumusta! Mabuhay! 'Nya munta quita na maga colores vinta. From Ciudad Latina de Asia Vintas are traditional boats originating from Mindanao, Philippines. The Bajao and Moros of Sulu and Zamboanga created these boats. They were made from dug-out canoes and installed with double outriggers. Bajao and people from Basilan and Tawi-tawi were known as great swimmers and people with great knowledge of the sea and oceans. It's locally known as "Lepa-lepa" or "Sakayan", and is used to transport goods and travelers for inter-island trips. The most remarkable traits of these boats are the colorful patterns of its sails. The Vinta basically signifies the general evolution of Sulu towards peace, progress and development. It is a representation of Zamboanga’s history and culture, and it is also one of the symbols that represent the Philippines as it signifies migration and the colorful traditions of the country. CONTENT: It has its own category under Transport You can build a simple docking place for vintas It has a small to medium culture, park, and bus transport influence And yeah, why don't we bring these influences on your seas, huh? Supported Languages: English and Filipino Mucho Colores! Ciudad de Zamboanga. ©Haráya Motors From low seas of Jeepneys "Ako ang iyong Haráya." ___ Land and Tree textures by Lobby from public templates.
plugins.descriptionHtml:
Kumusta! Mabuhay!
'Nya munta quita na maga colores vinta.
From Ciudad Latina de Asia

Vintas are traditional boats originating from Mindanao, Philippines. The Bajao and Moros of Sulu and Zamboanga created these boats. They were made from dug-out canoes and installed with double outriggers. Bajao and people from Basilan and Tawi-tawi were known as great swimmers and people with great knowledge of the sea and oceans.

It's locally known as "Lepa-lepa" or "Sakayan", and is used to transport goods and travelers for inter-island trips. The most remarkable traits of these boats are the colorful patterns of its sails. The Vinta basically signifies the general evolution of Sulu towards peace, progress and development.

It is a representation of Zamboanga’s history and culture, and it is also one of the symbols that represent the Philippines as it signifies migration and the colorful traditions of the country.

CONTENT:
It has its own category under Transport
You can build a simple docking place for vintas
It has a small to medium culture, park, and bus transport influence
And yeah, why don't we bring these influences on your seas, huh?

Supported Languages:
English and Filipino

Mucho Colores! Ciudad de Zamboanga.
©Haráya Motors
From low seas of Jeepneys
"Ako ang iyong Haráya."
___
Land and Tree textures by Lobby from public templates.

Modulable platform tool and decos

6 different trains
13 trailers

plugins.name: ATM World
plugins.description: Remove any previous version of Industrial trees.plugin or rename to _Industrial trees.plugin in your plugin folder. 1x1 RCI residential commercial industrial displacers. ATM worlds may form next to roads in each dense RCI zone. When a traffic event happens, they rebuild. You may click them then, obtain 100,000 Theons, and keep the zone or when a second traffic event occurs, waste disposal trees grow in this spot. These you may not remove except by fire. You may now upgrade these trees to blue taco poles, which when clicked give Theons and disappear. Or upgrade 12 to remove all waste disposal trees. Some 1x1 burnable trees will also grow in industrial zones. ATM Worlds are not placeable, but usually occur most often in new zones. Waste disposal trees are placeable, they may be found in the supply category. Waste disposal trees won't stay next to each other and will remove themselves at random times until one is left alone. The decorations that replace them on the south and west sides of roads may be upgraded to restore the zones. :) Up to 256 tiles will eventually be zoned with the zone of your choice. All trees in this plugin might catch fire at random times.

plugins.description: hoy, hello, didn't saw ya, i was waiting for ya, take a seat description This plugin add the famous Parisian Subway .
